text.body: <1> || śrīḥ|| sumadhvavijayaḥ prathamaḥ sargaḥ kāntāya kalyāṇaguṇaikadhāmne navadyunāthapratimaprabhāya | nārāyaṇāyākhilakāraṇāya śrīprāṇanāthāya namaskaromi || 1.1|| anākulaṃ gokulamullalāsa yatpālitaṃ nityamanāvilātma | tasmai namo nīradanīlabhāse kṛṣṇāya kṛṣṇāramaṇapriyāya || 1.2|| api trilokyā bahirullasantī tamoharantī muhurāntaraṃ ca | diśyād‌dṛśaṃ no viśadāṃ jayantī madhvasya kīrtirdinanāthadīptim‌ || 1.3|| tamonudā''nandamavāpa lokastattavapradīpākṛtigogaṇena | yadāsyaśītāṃśubhuvā gurūṃstāṃstrivikramāryān‌ praṇamāmi varyān‌ || 1.4|| mukundabhaktyai gurubhaktijāyai satāṃ prasattayai ca nirantarāyai | garīyasīṃ viśvagurorviśuddhāṃ vakṣyāmi vāyoravatāralīlām‌ || 1.5|| tāṃ mantravarṇairanuvarṇanīyāṃ śarvendrapūrvairapi vaktukāme | saṅkṣipnuvākye mayi mandabuddhau santo guṇāḍhyāḥ karuṇāṃ kriyāsuḥ || 1.6|| uccāvacā yena samastaceṣṭāḥ kiṃ tatra citraṃ caritaṃ nivedyam‌ | kintūttamaślokaśikhāmaṇīnāṃ manoviśuddhyai caritānuvādaḥ || 1.7|| mālākṛtastaccaritākhyaratnairasūkṣmadṛṣṭeḥ sakutūhalasya (sukutūhalasya) | pūrvāparīkāramathāparaṃ vā kṣāmyantu me hanta muhurmahāntaḥ || 1.8|| śrīvallabhājñāṃ sasurendrayāñcāṃ sambhāvya sambhāvyatamāṃ trilokyām‌ | prāṇeśvaraḥ prāṇigaṇapraṇetā guruḥ satāṃ kesariṇo gṛhe'bhūt‌ || 1.9|| ye ye guṇā nāma jagatprasiddhā yaṃ teṣu teṣu sma nidarśayanti | sākṣānmahābhāgavataprabarhaṃ śrīmantamenaṃ hanumantamāhuḥ || 1.10|| karmāṇi kurvan‌ paramādbhutāni sabhāsu daivīṣu sabhājitāni | sugrīvamitraṃ sajagatpavitraṃ ramāpatiṃ rāmatanuṃ dadarśa || 1.11|| pādāravindapraṇato harīndrastadā mahābhaktibharābhinunnaḥ | agrāhi padmodarasundarābhyāṃ dorbhyāṃ purāṇena sa pūruṣeṇa || 1.12|| adāryasālāvalidāraṇena vyāpāditendraprabhavena tena | prādyotaniprītikṛtā nikāmaṃ madhudviṣā sandidiśe sa vīraḥ || 1.13|| karṇāntamānīya guṇagrahītrā rāmeṇa mukto raṇa kovidena | sphurannasau vairibhayaṅkaro'bhūtsatpakṣapātī pradaro yathā'gryaḥ || 1.14|| gobhiḥ samānanditarūpasītaḥ svavahninirdagdhapalāśirāśiḥ | aho hanūmannavavārido'sau tīrṇāmbudhirviṣṇupade nanāma || 1.15|| apakṣapātī puruṣastrilokyāmabhogabhoktā patagādhirājam‌ | viśvambharaṃ bibhradasau jigāya tvarāparākrāntiṣu citrametat‌ || 1.16|| nibaddhya setuṃ raghuvaṃśaketu bhrūbhaṅgasambhrāntapayodhimadhye | muṣṭiprahāraṃ daśakāya sītā santarjanāgryottarameṣako'dāt‌ || 1.17|| jājvalyamānojjavalarāghavāgnau cakre sa sugrīvasuyāyajūke | ādhvaryavaṃ yuddhamakhe pratiprasthātrā sumitrātanayena sākam‌ || 1.18|| rāmārcane yo nayataḥ prasūnaṃ dvābhyāṃ karābhyāmabhavatprayatnaḥ | ekena doṣṇā nayato girīndraṃ sañjīvanādyāśrayamasya nābhūt‌ || 1.19|| sa dāritāriṃ paramaṃ pumāṃsaṃ samanvayāsīnnaradevaputryā | vahnipraveśādhigatātmaśuddhyā virājitaṃ kāñcanamālayeva || 1.20|| śyāmaṃ smitāsyaṃ pṛthudīrghahastaṃ sarojanetraṃ gajarājayātram‌ | vapurjaganmaṅgalameṣa dṛg‌bhyāṃ cirādayodhyādhipateḥ siṣeve || 1.21|| rājyābhiṣeke'vasite'tra sītā preṣṭhāya nastāṃ bhajatāṃ diśeti | rāmasya vāṇyā maṇimañjumālāvyājena dīrghāṃ karuṇāṃ babandha || 1.22|| hṛdorusauhārdabhṛtā'dhimaulinyastena hastena dayārdradṛṣṭ‌yā | sevāprasanno'mṛtakalpavācā dideśa devaḥ sahabhogamasmai || 1.23|| preṣṭho na rāmasya babhūva tasmān‌ na rāmarājye'sulabhaṃ ca kiñcit‌ | tatpādasevāratireṣa naicchat‌ tathāpi bhogānnanu sā viraktiḥ || 1.24|| namo namo nātha namo namaste namo namo rāma namo namaste | punaḥpunaste caraṇāravindaṃ namāmi nātheti naman‌ sa reme || 1.25|| kiṃ varṇayāmaḥ paramaṃ prasādaṃ sītāpatestatra hariprabarhe | muñcanmahīṃ nityaniṣevaṇārthaṃ svātmānamevaiṣa dadau yadasmai || 1.26|| svānandahetau bhajatāṃ janānāṃ magnaḥ sadā rāmakathāsudhāyām‌ | asāvidānīṃ ca niṣevamāṇo rāmaṃ patiṃ kimpuruṣe kilāste || 1.27|| tasyaiva vāyoravatāramenaṃ santo dvitīyaṃ pravadanti bhīmam‌ | spṛṣṭ‌yaiva yaṃ prītimatā'nilena narendrakāntā suṣuve'tra kuntī || 1.28|| indrāyudhaṃ hīndrakarābhinunnaṃ ciccheda pakṣān‌ kṣitidhāriṇāṃ prāk‌ | bibheda bhūbhṛd‌vapuraṅgasaṅgāccitraṃ sa panno jananīkarāgrāt‌ || 1.29|| pure kumāranalasānvihārān‌ nirīkṣya sarvānapi mandalīlaḥ | kaiśoralīlāṃ hatasimhasaṅghāṃ vane pravṛttāṃ smarati sma sūtkaḥ || 1.30|| bhuktaṃ ca jīrṇaṃ paripanthidattaṃ viṣaṃ viṣaṇṇo viṣabhṛd‌guṇo'taḥ | pramāṇakoṭeḥ sa hi helayā'gānnedaṃ jagajjīvanade'tra citram‌ || 1.31|| dagdhvā puraṃ yogabalāt‌ sa niryandharmāniva svān‌ sahajān‌ dadhānaḥ | adāribhāvena jagat‌ supūjyo yogīva nārāyaṇamāsasāda || 1.32|| samarpya kṛtyāni kṛtī kṛtāni vyāsāya bhūmne sukṛtāni tāvat‌ | kariṣyamāṇāni ca tasya pūjāṃ saṅkalpayāmāsa sa śuddhabuddhiḥ || 1.33|| viṣṇoḥ padaśridbakasaṅnirāsī kṣiptānyapakṣiprakaraḥ supakṣaḥ | sasodaro'thādita rājahaṃsaḥ sa rājahaṃsīmiva rājakanyām‌ || 1.34|| indīvaraśrījayasundarābhaṃ smerānanenduṃ dayitaṃ mukundam‌ | svamātuleyaṃ kamalāyatākṣaṃ samabhyanandatsucirāya bhīmaḥ || 1.35|| mahāgadaṃ caṇḍaraṇaṃ pṛthivyāṃ bārhadrathaṃ maṅkṣu nirasya vīraḥ | rājānamatyujjavalarājsūyaṃ cakāra govindasurendrajābhyām‌ || 1.36|| duḥśāsanenākulitān‌ priyāyāḥ sūkṣmānarālānasitāṃśca keśān‌ | jighaṃsayā vairijanasya tīkṣṇaḥ sa kṛṣṇasarpāniva sañcikāya || 1.37|| jājvalyamānasya vane vane'laṃ didhakṣataḥ pārthivasārthamugram‌ | sattavāni puṃsāṃ bhayadāni nāśaṃ vṛkodarāgnergurutejasā''puḥ || 1.38|| bhogādhikābhogavato'ruṇākṣānitastataḥ sañcalato dharendre | bahūndvijihvān‌ maṇimatpurogān‌ asau kaṭūn‌ krodhavaśān‌ jaghāna || 1.39|| athaiṣa veṣāntarabhasmalīnaḥ krameṇa vāyuprabhavaḥ sutejāḥ | ruddhākhilāśaṃ mukharaṃ pracaṇḍaṃ bhasmīcakārākhilakīcakaugham‌ || 1.40|| sa kṛṣṇavartmā vijayena yukto muhurmahāhetidharo'pradhṛṣyaḥ | bhīṣmadvijādyairatibhīṣaṇābhaṃ vipakṣakakṣaṃ kṣapayan‌ vireje || 1.41|| tarasvinaḥ proccalitānadhīrān‌ nirdagdhapakṣānatitīkṣṇakopān‌ | sa dhārtarāṣṭrān‌ bahuhetilīlo vināśya viśvān‌ parayā śriyā'bhāt‌ || 1.42|| kṛṣṇāṅghripaṅkeruhabhṛṅgarājaḥ kṛṣṇāmukhāmbhoruhahaṃsarājaḥ | prajāsarojāvaliraśmirājaḥ sasodaro'rājata vīrarājaḥ || 1.43|| pautre pavitrāhvayajāmipautre dharāṃ nidhāyāsuradhīṣu tāpam‌ | kīrtiṃ trilokyāṃ hṛdaye mukundaṃ bheje padaṃ svaṃ sahajaiḥ sa bhīmaḥ || 1.44|| viṣṇoḥ padāntaṃ bhajatā'nilena ghorapraghātairiti nāśitāste | rasojjahitāścañcalavṛttayo'laṃ śobhāṃ na bhejuḥ suravairimeghāḥ || 1.45|| etat‌ pratīpaṃ kila kartukāmā naṣṭaujasaḥ saṅkaṭamevamāpya | mukundavaiguṇyakathāṃ svayogyāṃ kāle kalāvākalayanta te'lam‌ || 1.46|| yo bhūrivairo maṇimān‌ mṛtaḥ prāg‌ vāgmī bubhūṣuḥ paritoṣiteśaḥ | sa saṅkarākhyo'ṅghritaleṣu jajñe spṛdhā'pare'pyāsurihāsurendrāḥ || 1.47|| sānnāyyamavyaktahṛdākhubhug‌vā śvā vā puroḍāśamasārakāmaḥ | maṇisrajaṃ vā plavago'vyavastho jagrāha vedādikameṣa pāpaḥ || 1.48|| jano namennāparatheti mattavā śaṭhaścaturthāśramameṣa bheje | padmākaraṃ vā kaluṣaṃ cikīrṣuḥ sudurdamo duṣṭagajo viśuddham‌ || 1.49|| avaidikaṃ mādhyamikaṃ nirastaṃ nirīkṣya tatpakṣasupakṣapātī | tameva pakṣaṃ pratipāduko'sau nyarūrupan‌ mārgamihānurūpam‌ || 1.50|| asatpade'sansadasadviviktaṃ māyākhyayā saṃvṛtimabhyadhatta | brahmāpyakhanḍaṃ bata śūnyasiddhyai pracchannabauddho'yamataḥ prasiddhaḥ || 1.51|| yad‌ brahmasūtrotkarabhāskaraṃ ca prakāśayantaṃ sakalaṃ svagobhiḥ | acūcurad‌ vedasamūhavāhaṃ tato mahātaskaramenamāhuḥ || 1.52|| svasūtrajātasya viruddhabhāṣī tad‌bhāṣyakāro'hamiti bruvan‌ yaḥ | taṃ tatkṣaṇādyo na didhakṣati sma sa vyāsarūpo bhagavān‌ kṣamābdhiḥ || 1.53|| nigamasanmaṇidīpagaṇo'bhavat‌ taduruvāggaṇapaṅkanigūḍhabhāḥ | aviduṣāmiti saṅkaratākaraḥ sa kila saṅkara ityabhiśuśruve || 1.54|| viśvaṃ mithyā vibhuraguṇavān‌ ātmanāṃ nāsti bhedo | daityā itthaṃ vyadadhata girāṃ dikṣu bhūyaḥ prasiddhim‌ | ānandādyairguruguṇagaṇaiḥ pūrito vāsudevo | mandaṃ mandaṃ manasi ca satāṃ hanta nūnaṃ tiro'bhūt‌ || 1.55|| iti śrīmatkavikulatilaka trivikramapaṇḍitācāryasuta nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācāryaviracite śrīmatsumadhvavijaye mahākāvye ānandāṅke prathamaḥ sargaḥ <2> dvitīyaḥ sargaḥ vijñānabhānumati kālabalena līne durbhāṣyasantamasasantatito jane'ndhe | mārgāt‌ satāṃ skhalati khinnahṛdo mukundaṃ devāścaturmukhamukhāḥ śaraṇaṃ prajagmuḥ || 2.1|| nāthaḥ kalau triyugahūtiranudbubhūṣuḥ brahmāṇamapyanavatāramanādidikṣuḥ | sarvajñamanyamanavekṣya sakāryavīryaṃ smerānano bhuvana jīvanamābabhāṣe || 2.2|| vedāntamārgaparimārgaṇadīnadūnā daivīḥ prajā viśaraṇāḥ karuṇāpadaṃ naḥ | ānandayeḥ sumukha bhūṣitabhūmibhāgo rūpāntareṇa mama sadguṇanirṇayena || 2.3|| ādeśamaulimaṇimujjavalavarṇamenaṃ baddhāñjalirmarudanarghamadhattamūrdhnā | hārāvalīmiva hṛdā vibudhendrayāñcāṃ bibhrannijānanujighṛkṣuravātitīrṣat‌ || 2.4|| kālaḥ sa eva samavartata nāma yāvat‌ cintākulaṃ vividhasādhukulaṃ babhūva | vedāntasantatakṛtāntarasaṃ na vidmaḥ śreyo labhemahi kathaṃ nu vayaṃ bateti || 2.5|| tatprītaye rajatapīṭhapurādhivāsī devo viveśa puruṣaṃ śubhasūcanāya | prāpte mahāya mahitāya mahājanaughe kolāhalena sukutūhalini pravṛtte || 2.6|| āviṣṭavānakuśalaṃ puruṣaṃ prakṛtyā pratyāyayannijajanānnitarāmanṛtyat‌ | uttuṅgaketuśikhare sa kṛtāṅgahāro raṅgāntare naṭa ivākhilavismayātmā || 2.7|| ābhāṣya so'tra janatāṃ śapathānuviddhaṃ uccairidaṃ vacanamuddhṛtadorbabhāṣe | utpatsyate jagati viśvajanīnavṛttiḥ viśvajña eva bhagavānacirādiheti || 2.8|| sadvīpavārinidhisaptakabhūtadhātryā madhye'pi karmabhuvi bhāratanāmakhaṇḍe | kāle kalau suvimalānvayalabdhajanmā sanmadhyagehakulamaulimaṇirdvijo'bhūt‌ || 2.9|| vedādrisadrajatapīṭhapureśvarābhyāṃ grāmo vibhūṣitataraḥ śivarūpyanāmā | hemādrirājavibhurājadilāvṛtābha stasyābhavad‌ guruguṇaḥ khalu mūlabhūmiḥ || 2.10|| rāmādhiveśitaharisvasṛmaulimālā rājadvimānagiriśobhitamadhyuvāsa | kṣetraṃ sa pājakapadaṃ trikulaikaketuḥ kaṃ yaddadhāti satataṃ khalu viśvapājāt‌ || 2.11|| arthaṃ kamapyanavamaṃ puruṣārthahetuṃ puṃsāṃ pradātumucitāmucitasvarūpām‌ | kanyāṃ suvarṇalasitāmiva vedavidyāṃ jagrāha vipravṛṣabhapratipāditāṃ saḥ || 2.12|| reme'cchayopaniṣadeva mahāviveko bhaktyaiva śuddhakaraṇaḥ paramaśritā'lam‌ | mithyābhimānarahitaḥ parayeva muktyā svānandasantatikṛtā sa tayā dvijendraḥ || 2.13|| tasya prabhoścaraṇayoḥ kuladevatāyā bhaktiṃ babandha nijadharmarataḥ sa dhīraḥ | vijñātabhāratapurāṇamahārahasyaṃ yaṃ bhaṭṭa ityabhivadanti janā vinītam‌ || 2.14|| govindasundarakathāsudhayā sa nṝṇāṃ ānandayanna kila kevalamindriyāṇi | kintu prabho rajatapīṭhapure padābjaṃ śrīvallabhasya bhajatāmapi daivatānām‌ || 2.15|| itthaṃ harerguṇakathāsudhayā sutṛpto nairguṇyavādiṣu janeṣvapi sāgraheṣu | tattave sa kālacaladhīratisaṃśayāluḥ dhīmān‌ dhiyā śravaṇaśodhitayā pradadhyau || 2.16|| trātā ya eva narakātsa hi putranāmā mukhyāvanaṃ na sulabhaṃ puruṣādapūrṇāt‌ | tasmātsamastavidapatyamavadyahīnaṃ vidyākarākṛti labhemahi kairupāyaiḥ || 2.17|| pūrve'pi kardamaparāśarapāṇḍumukhyā yatsevayā guṇagaṇāḍhyamapatyamāpuḥ | taṃ pūrṇasad‌guṇatanuṃ karuṇāmṛtābdhiṃ nārāyaṇaṃ kulapatiṃ śaraṇaṃ vrajema || 2.18|| itthaṃ vicintya sa vicintyamananyabandhuḥ preṣṭhapradaṃ rajatapīṭhapurādhivāsam‌ | bhaktyā bhavābdhibhayabhaṅgadayā śubhātmā bheje bhujaṅgaśayanaṃ dviṣaḍabdakālam‌ || 2.19|| patnyā samaṃ bhagavataḥ sa bhajan‌ padābjaṃ bhogān‌ laghūnapi punarlaghayāñcakāra | dāntaṃ svayaṃ ca hṛdayaṃ damayāñcakāra svacchaṃ ca dehamadhikaṃ vimalīcakāra || 2.20|| tīvraiḥ payovratamukhairvividhairvratāgryai rjāyāpatī guṇagaṇārṇavaputrakāmau | sampūrṇapūruṣamatoṣayatāṃ nitāntaṃ deveritāviva purā'ditikaśyapau tau || 2.21|| nāthasya bhūrikaruṇāsudhayā'bhiṣiktau śrīśrīdharapratatisāraśarīrayaṣṭī | bhūrivrataprabhavadivyasukāntimantau tau dehaśuddhimatimātramathālabhetām‌ || 2.22|| kāntādṛtau samucite'tha babhāra garbhaṃ sā bhūsurendraduhitā jagatāṃ sukhāya | acchāmbareva rajanī paripūritāśā bhāvinyapāstatamasaṃ vidhumādyapakṣāt‌ || 2.23|| taṃ pūrvapakṣasitabimbamiva pravṛddhaṃ yāvad‌ dvijendravanitā suṣuve'tra tāvat‌ | aṃśena vāyuravatīrya sa rūpyapīṭhe viṣṇuṃ praṇamya bhavanaṃ prayayau tadīyam‌ || 2.24|| sampūrṇalakṣaṇacaṇaṃ navarājamāna dvārāntaraṃ paramasundaramandiraṃ tat‌ | rajeva satpuravaraṃ bhuvanādhirājo niṣkāsayan‌ paramasau bhagavānviveśa || 2.25|| santuṣyatāṃ sakalasannikarairasadbhiḥ khidyeta vāyurayamāvirabhūt‌ pṛthivyām‌ | ākhyannitīva suradundubhimandranādaḥ prāśrāvi kautukavaśairiha mānavaiśca || 2.26|| nāthaṃ niṣevya bhavanānatidūramāptaḥ prājño mahaprakṛtadundubhinādapūrvāt‌ | putrodbhavaśravaṇato mahadāpya saukhyaṃ jñānaṃ parokṣapadamapyamateṣṭahetum‌ || 2.27|| āviśya veśma nijanandanaminduvaktraṃ bhūyo'bhinandya sa mukundadayāṃ pravandya | jātasya tasya guṇajātavahasya jāta karmādikarmanivahaṃ vidadhe sukarmā || 2.28|| jñānārthameva yadabhūdasudeva eṣa yadvāsudeva padabhaktirataḥ sadā'sau | tadvāsudevapadamanvavadan‌ surendrā stātena yannigaditaṃ sutanāmakartrā || 2.29|| pātuṃ payāṃsi śiśave kila goprado'smai pūrvālayaḥ svasutasūnutayā prajātaḥ | nirvāṇahetumalabhīṣṭa parātmavidyāṃ dānaṃ dhruvaṃ phalati pātraguṇānukūlyāt‌ || 2.30|| atrastameva satataṃ pariphullacakṣuḥ kāntyā viḍambitanavendu jagatyanarghyam‌ | tatputraratnamupagṛhya kadācidāptaḥ svasvāmine budha upāyanamārpayatsaḥ || 2.31|| natvā hariṃ rajatapīṭhapurādhivāsaṃ bālasya sampadamanāpadamarthayitvā | sākaṃ sutena parivārajanānvito'sau prāyānniśīthasamaye nijameva dhāma || 2.32|| doṣeyuṣāṃ samamanena vane'tibhīme tatkrīḍitagraha ihaikatamaṃ tutoda | udvāntaraktamavalokya tamabhyadhāyi kenāpyaho na śiśutut‌ kathameṣa ittham‌ || 2.33|| āviśya pūruṣamuvāca mahāgraho'sau asmadvihārasamayopagatān‌ samastān‌ | yacchaktiguptirahitānalamasmi hantuṃ lokeśvaraḥ sa bata bālatamaḥ kileti || 2.34|| stanyena bālamanutoṣya muhuḥ svadhāmno mātā kadācana yayau virahāsahā'pi | viśvasya viśvaparipālakapālanāya kanyāṃ nijāmanuguṇāṃ kila bhīrureṣā || 2.35|| sā bālakaṃ praruditaṃ parisāntvayantī mugdhākṣareṇa vacasā'nunināya mugdhā | mā tāta tāta sumukheti punaḥ prarodī rmātā tanoti rucitaṃ tvaritaṃ taveti || 2.36|| rode kriyāsamabhihārata eva vṛtte potasya mātari cirādapi nāgatāyām‌ | jagrāha bālamatha caikṣata mātṛmārgaṃ sā'pi kriyāsamabhihārata eva bālā || 2.37|| kartavyamauḍhyamabhipadya nirūpya sā taṃ prābhojayat‌ khalu kulitthakulaṃ prapakvam‌ | śītaṃ payo'pi satataṃ paripāyayantī yasyoṣṇarogamativelamaśaṅkatāmbā || 2.38|| nūnaṃ pipāsuratiroditi hanta bālo dhiṅ‌ māṃ dayāvirahitāṃ parakṛtyasaktām‌ | ityākulā gṛhamupetya tadā prasannaṃ purṇodaraṃ sutamavaikṣata viprapatnī || 2.39|| pṛṣṭvā'vagamya sakalaṃ ca tataḥ pravṛttaṃ yūnāṃ ca duḥsahamidaṃ śiśunopabhuktam‌ | itthaṃ vicintya tanayāṃ bahu bhartsayantyā bhītaṃ tayā'nu kupitaṃ manasā'nutaptam‌ || 2.40|| ārogyaśālini tadā'pi pureva putre vismeratāmupajagāma jananyamuṣya | yasya trilokajananī jananī viṣe'pi pīte na vismayamavāpa samastaśakteḥ || 2.41|| stanyaṃ muhuḥ kila dadau jananī gṛhītvā kṣemāya taṃ kila dadhajjanako jajāpa | anyo jano'pi kila lālayati sma kintu sarvo'pi tanmukhasuhāsarasāyanotkaḥ || 2.42|| devādisadbhiranupālitayā'dareṇa devyātmaneva vilasatpadayā nitāntam‌ | avyaktayā prathamato vadane'sya vāṇyā śālīnayeva bhuvanārcitayā vijahre || 2.43|| pragriṅkhaṇaṃ svayamatha stithimeṣa cakre paścādgatiṃ paricayena kila krameṇa | viśvasya ceṣṭitamaho yadanugraheṇa sarvaṃ tadasya pavanasya viḍambanaṃ hi || 2.44|| pucchāntamacchamavalambya kadācideṣa prātarvrajādvrajata eva nijarraṣabhasya | prāyāt‌ priyasya sahasā svajanairadṛṣṭo nanāvaneṣu carataścaratastṛṇāni || 2.45|| uttuṅgaśṛṅgalasitasya mahiṣṭhamūrteḥ pādāvṛtāvanitalasya surandhrakasya | āśritya tasya śuśubhe'vayavaikadeśaṃ bālo divākara ivodayaparvatasya || 2.46|| līlāṃ karoti nu gṛhāntarago nu bālaḥ kūpāntare nu patitaḥ prakṛtisvatantraḥ | itthaṃ vicintya sa muhuḥ svajano vimṛgya hantānavekṣya tanayaṃ hṛdi tāpamāpa || 2.47|| bālasya bālaparilambanagocaraṃ tadvaśvasyatāpivacanaṃ vanagocaroktam‌ | yat‌ sāyamaikṣata janaḥ śiśumāvrajantaṃ ekābdakaṃ vṛṣabhabālakṛtāvalambam‌ || 2.48|| cintāmaṇīndramiva cintitadaṃ daridro vijñānamārgamiva viṣṇuparaṃ mumukṣuḥ | naṣṭaṃ ca nandanamiti svajano'sya labdhvā nāthasya tasya tamanugrahameva mene || 2.49|| līlāvasānasamaye sahasā kadācit‌ āryo'munā'bhyavahṛtiṃ prati codyamānaḥ | roddhaiṣa no'sti dhaniko vṛṣavikrayīti provāca nandanamukhendumavekṣya mandam‌ || 2.50|| līlākareṇa sa kareṇa sukomalena bījāntarāṇi kila kānicidāśu tasmai | smitvā'rbhako'bhimataniṣkapade yadā'dā dādatta tāni dhaniko bahumānapūrvam‌ || 2.51|| labdhaṃ sutāditi vadan‌ dvijapuṅgavena kālāntare nijadhane pratiditsite'pi | sākṣādamānavanavākṛtitaḥ sa lebhe bījacchalena puruṣārthamaho viśiṣṭam‌ || 2.52|| vāsudevamiha vāsudevatāsatkalāmabhinananda taṃ janaḥ | vāsudevamiti vāsudevasannāmakaṃ vividhalīlamarbhakam‌ || 2.53|| iti viharati mahyāṃ viṣṇudāse'pi gūḍhe samajani sujanānāṃ cittamānandapūrṇam‌ | udayati ghanamālālīnabhānau ca bhānau nanu jananayanābjairlabhyate'laṃ vikāsaḥ || 2.54|| iti śrīmatkavikulatilaka trivikramapaṇḍitācāryasuta nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācāryaviracite śrīmatsumadhvavijaye mahākāvye ānandāṅke dvitīyaḥ sargaḥ <3> tṛtīyaḥ sargaḥ atha kadācana sundaranandanasmitamukhendudṛśāṃ dayitau nṛṇām‌ | mahamito nijabandhumude mudā prayayatuḥ svajanaiḥ saha dampatī || 3.1|| svajanatāpagamāgamasaṅgamapratisabhājitapūrvakasambhrame | aviduṣī jananīti sa bālakaḥ śaraṇato raṇato niragānnṛbhiḥ || 3.2|| kva nu yiyāsasi tāta na sāmprataṃ svajanasantyajanaṃ tava sāmpratam‌ | iti vibhuḥ pathikairudito vrajan‌ smitamanākulamuttaramātanot‌ || 3.3|| tvaritametya sa kānanadevatāsadanamatra nanāma ramāpatim‌ | api tataḥ pragato laghunārikelyupapadāntarasadmagataṃ ca tam‌ || 3.4|| nalinanābhanibhālanasanmadāgamavikasvarabhāsvaralocanaḥ | janamanonayanāmbujabhāskaro rajatapīṭhapuraṃ prayayāvasau || 3.5|| suhayamedhagaṇātiśayālavo harinamaskṛtayaḥ sukṛtā imāḥ | iti surairapi bhūsuramaṇḍalaiḥ samanamat‌ sa savismayamīkṣitaḥ || 3.6|| na hi hariṃ satataṃ na namatyasau na ca na paśyati nāpi na vandate | api tatheti vidhāya viśeṣataḥ sa nanu sādhujanān‌ samaśikṣayat‌ || 3.7|| anavalokya sutaṃ sutavatsalo mṛgayati sma mahīsurapuṅgavaḥ | muhurapṛcchadamuṣya gatiṃ narān‌ pathi pathi pragato'nupadaṃ drutam‌ || 3.8|| janasadāgatisūcitavartmanā pratipadaṃ vrajatā parayā tṛṣā | dvijamahāmadhupena manoharaṃ smitamalābhi sutānanavārijam‌ || 3.9|| virahadūnatayodgamanonmukhaṃ nyaruṇadaśru purā sa yayordṛśoḥ | atha tayoḥ pramadotthitamapyadaḥ pratinirudhya giraṃ gururabravīt‌ || 3.10|| ayi sutedamudāhara tattavato nanu samāgatavānasi sāmpratam‌ | svajanatārahitasya tu ko'tra te sahacaro'rbhaka dīrghatame pathi || 3.11|| janakavācamimāmavadhārayan‌ kalamudāharadamburuhekṣaṇaḥ | svapadamāvrajato vrajato'pyato nanu sakhā mama kānanago vibhuḥ || 3.12|| taditarāyatanāttu yadāgamaṃ kṛtanatiḥ khalu tatra hariḥ sakhā | ahamihāpi mahendradigālayaṃ praṇatavānuta yāvadadhīśvaram‌ || 3.13|| api tato'hamupetya sahāmunā bhagavate'tra sate praṇatiṃ vyadhām‌ | iti nigadya vibhāti śiśuḥ sma vismitasabhājanacīrṇasabhājanaḥ || 3.14|| virahitasvajanaṃ caraṇapriyaṃ vividhabhūtabhayaṅkaravartmani | ayi kṛpālaya pālaya bālakaṃ laghuśubhasya mametyanamad‌ dvijaḥ || 3.15|| tamupagṛhya sutaṃ sutaponidhirgṛhamasau gṛhiṇīsahito yayau | udayatīti hi bāladivākare smitamabhūt‌ sujanānanavārijam‌ || 3.16|| varavimānagirāvapi caṇḍikā śiśumaho jananī tamalālayat‌ | aparathā parituṣṭamanāḥ kathaṃ ciramihaiṣa vasedvisahāyakaḥ || 3.17|| sakalaśabdamayī ca sarasvatī satatamānamati svayameva yam‌ | dvijavaro'tha kadācana mātṛkāḥ kila sutaṃ paricāyayati sma tam‌ || 3.18|| lipikulaṃ nanu tāta gate dine likhitameva punarlikhitaṃ kutaḥ | iti nijapratibhāguṇabhāvitaṃ haripadasya vacastamanandayat‌ || 3.19|| śiśurasau pratibhāmbudhirityalaṃ janamanovacanagrahapīḍanā | na bhavatāditi taṃ vijanasthale svatanayaṃ samaśikṣayadeṣakaḥ || 3.20|| mahavatā svajanena samīritasvajananīsahitena kadācana | ruciravācanayā'rcitavāk‌śriyā prati yaye prabhuṇā ghṛtavalyapi || 3.21|| pariṣadā nitarāṃ parivāritaḥ śivapadaḥ kila dhautapaṭodbhavaḥ | iha kathāṃ kathayan‌ dadṛśe tataḥ pṛthudhiyā pṛthukākṛtinā'munā || 3.22|| idamuvāca vicāravicakṣaṇaḥ śucivacaḥ śanakaiḥ sa janāntare | aparathā kathitaṃ kathaka tvayā nanu matāt‌ mahatāmiti sasmitam‌ || 3.23|| agaṇayanna śivaṃ janatā tadā savacane vasudevasutāhvaye | mukharamicchati ko mṛgadhūrtakaṃ prakṛtahuṅkṛtasimhaśiśau sati || 3.24|| atha kathāṃ (kathaṃ) kathayeti tadā jane gaditavatyucitārthamudāharat‌ | sa samalālyata vismayibhirnarairapi surairvijayāṅkurapūjakaiḥ || 3.25|| sa jananīsahito janakaṃ gṛhe pragatavāṃstamudantamavedayat‌ | nigada tāta śivaḥ kathakaḥ sa kiṃ vitathagīrathavā'hamitīrayan‌ || 3.26|| nanu sutāvitathaṃ kathitaṃ tvayetyamumudīrya savismayamasmarat‌ | prakṛtitaḥ kṛtitā khalu me śiśormadadhināthadayodayajetyasau || 3.27|| kathayatāṃ prathame kathayatyalaṃ svajanake janasaṅghavṛte kathām‌ | sakalalokamanonayanotsavaścaturadhīḥ sa kadācidavācayat‌ || 3.28|| vividhaśākhipadārthanivedane likucanāmni tadā'nuditārthake | kimiti tāta tadarthamavarṇayan‌ kathayasīti śanairayamabravīt‌ || 3.29|| avadatīti pitaryapi codite pratibubhutsuṣu tatra janeṣvapi || ayamudīrya tadarthamavāptavān‌ pariṣado hyasamānasumānanām‌ || 3.30|| bahuvidhaiścaritairiti cārubhiḥ sakalalokakutūhalakāriṇam‌ | dvijavareṇa vayasyucite sthitaṃ tamupanetumanena dadhe manaḥ || 3.31|| samucitagrahayogaguṇānvitaṃ samavadhārya muhūrtamadūṣaṇam‌ | praṇayabandhurabāndhavavānasau dvijakulākulamutsavamātanot‌ || 3.32|| vividhavedatayā vijihīrṣavo vadanaraṅgapade'sya cirāya yāḥ | suravarapramadā api sapriyā abhinananduraho viyato maham‌ || 3.33|| vihitasādhanasādhitasatkriyojjavalanamujjavaladhīrjvalayannayam‌ | upanināya sutaṃ samalaṅkṛtaṃ kuśalinaṃ kuśalīkṛtaśīrṣakam‌ || 3.34|| paricarāgnigurū caritavrataḥ sucaraṇaḥ paṭha sādhu sadāgamān‌ | iti gurostrijagadguruśikṣaṇe sphuṭamahāsi suraiḥ kṛtasākṣibhiḥ || 3.35|| jitakumāraguṇaṃ sukumārakaṃ nijakumāramavekṣya nirantaram‌ | samucitācaraṇe caturaṃ svataḥ kṣitisuro mudamāyata śikṣayan‌ || 3.36|| sa paṭakhaṇḍamakiñcanavat‌ kvacit‌ svavibhavānucitaṃ caraṇādikam‌ | bhuvanabharturaho svanigūhanaṃ surasabhāsu kutūhalamātanot‌ || 3.37|| aviralairgaraloṣmabhirākulīkṛtasamastajano vicacāra yaḥ | kvacidamuṃ nijaghāṅsuraśāntimānupasasarpa sa sarpamayo'suraḥ || 3.38|| tvaritamudyatavistṛtamastakaḥ pratidadaṃśa yadainamavikṣatam‌ | prabhupadāruṇacārutarāṅgulīvihṛtipiṣṭatanuḥ pratatāma saḥ || 3.39|| garuḍatuṇḍamiva pratipannavān‌ dvijakumārapadaṃ sa mamāra ca | samucitaṃ caritaṃ mahatāmidaṃ sumanaso manaseṣṭamapūjayan‌ || 3.40|| giriśagurvamarendramukhaiśca yaccaraṇareṇuradhāri surādhipaiḥ | kṣitisurāṅghryabhivandanapūrvakaṃ sa vidadhe'dhyayanaṃ chalamānuṣaḥ || 3.41|| karatale khalu kandukavat‌ sadā sakalayā kalayā saha vidyayā | aridhareṇa samaṃ sphuritaṃ gurormanasi tasya viḍambayato janān‌ || 3.42|| anadhikairadhikaiśca vayasyatho bahubhiradhyayanoparamāntare | anikaṭe vaṭubhiḥ paṭubhirguroḥ sa vijahāra sukhī sakhibhiḥ samam‌ || 3.43|| padamudīrya javena yiyāsitaṃ drutasakheṣvabhavat‌ sa puraḥsaraḥ | ayamayatnatayeti na vismayo nanu manojavajit‌ pavano hyasau || 3.44|| plavanatejasi hanta na kevalaṃ vijitavān‌ sa tadā sakalān‌ janān‌ | prabhunideśakaro hanumattanau nanu jigāya sa vālisutādikān‌ || 3.45|| jalavihāraparājayibhiḥ spṛdhā sakhibhirīritavāripariśritam‌ | vadanamākulalocanamādadhe smitamamuṣya hi kañcana vibhramam‌ || 3.46|| sa śanakairbalino yugapadgatān‌ pravihṛteṣu sakhīn‌ nirapātayat‌ | aśanakairyugapat‌ prakṛtāhavān‌ sahasito dvijasūnurayatnavān‌ || 3.47|| grahaṇanigrahaṇe grahaṇe dṛḍhe gurubharoddharaṇādividhau paṭau | iha vibhāvupacāradhiyā nṛṇāmṛtamayaṃ nanu bhīma itīritam‌ || 3.48|| viharatīti paṭhatyapi na sphuṭaṃ svagṛhagāmini cādrutamāyati | paritutoṣa na tatra jagad‌gurau sa kila pūgavanānvayajo dvijaḥ || 3.49|| atha kadācana so'dhyayanāntare tamavadat‌ kupito'nyamanasvinam‌ | paṭhasi no śaṭha te sakhibhiḥ samaṃ kimiti nityamudāsitadhīriti || 3.50|| guṇanikā caraṇādikagocarā na mama hṛddayitetyudite'munā | vada viśāradavāda yathepsitaṃ tvamuparītyavadaddharaṇīsuraḥ || 3.51|| sakalalakṣaṇaśikṣaṇamūlabhūḥ śrutisamāmananaṃ skhalanojhjhitam‌ | na khalu kevalamasya gurorvyadhāt‌ sumanasāmapi tatra kutūhalam‌ || 3.52|| priyavayasyaśiroguruvedanāmaśamayat‌ sahajāmapi duḥsahām‌ | sa vipine vijane mukhavāyunā śravaṇagocaritena kadācana || 3.53|| adhigatopaniṣacca sakṛcchrutā prakaṭabhāgavatīti na vismayaḥ | adhigatā nanu jātvapi na śrutāḥ pratibhayā śrutayaḥ śataśo'munā || 3.54|| sākṣādathopaniṣado vibhuraittareyyāḥ pāṭhacchalena vijane'rtharasān‌ bruvāṇaḥ | adhyāpakāya vitatāra vimokṣabījaṃ govindabhaktimucitāṃ gurudakṣiṇāṃ saḥ || 3.55|| ayi svāmin‌ duṣṭān‌ damaya damaya vyaktamacirāt‌ guṇān‌ gūḍhān‌ viṣṇoḥ kathaya kathaya svān‌ pramadayan‌ | tadā'nandaṃ tanvanniti sumanasāṃ so'nusaratā manujñāmādatta tribhuvanagururbrāhmaṇaguroḥ || 3.56|| iti śrīmatkavikulatilaka trivikramapaṇḍitācāryasuta nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācāryaviracite śrīmatsumadhvavijaye mahākāvye ānandāṅke tṛtīyaḥ sargaḥ <4> caturthaḥ sargaḥ athaiṣa sallokadayāsudhārdrayā sadāgamastena nirāsakāmayā | ramāvarāvāsabhuvā viśārado viśālayā'cintayadātmano dhiyā || 4.1|| ananyasaṅgād‌ guṇasaṅgitā harerjanasya mānaṃ tu viśiṣṭaceṣṭitam‌ | asaṅgamasmāt‌ prakaṭīkaromyahaṃ nijaṃ bhajan‌ pāramahaṃsyamāśramam‌ || 4.2|| mama prabhornāparathā hi śobhate dviṣatsu viṣṇuṃ yadadaṇḍadhāraṇam‌ | harisvasā nanvacirādasadbhide bhavedato nāsmi ca daṇḍadhārakaḥ || 4.3|| vicintayannitthamanantacintakaḥ samastasanyāsanibaddhaniścayaḥ | asāvanujñārthamathānamaddhariṃ samastasaṃvyāpinamātmadāyagam‌ || 4.4|| nije jane kiṃ namasīti pṛcchati bruvan‌ svavastupraṇatiṃ vyadhāmiti | guroḥ kilānveṣaṇavān‌ jagadgurustadā jagāmākhilalokaśikṣakaḥ || 4.5|| yatiryatātmā bhuvi kaścanābhavadvibhūṣaṇo bhūriviraktibhūṣaṇaḥ | na nāmamātrācchucimarthato'pi yaṃ jano'cyutaprekṣamudāharat‌ sphuṭam‌ || 4.6|| puraiṣa kṛṣṇākarasiddhaśuddhimadvarānnabhuktyā kila pāṇḍavālaye | viśodhitātmā madhukṛtpravṛttimāṃścacāra kāṃścit‌ parivatsarān‌ mudā || 4.7|| abhūtkuśāstrābhyasanaṃ na pātakaṃ kramāgatādvipratisārato yateḥ | yathā kuśastrādhyasanaṃ muradviṣaḥ padāmbuje vyādhavarasya garhitam‌ || 4.8|| vinītamāmnāyaśiroviśāradaṃ sadaiva tattavaṃ prabubhutsumādarāt‌ | gururviditvopagatāṃ nijāṃ mṛtiṃ kadācidūce tamupahvare giram‌ || 4.9|| ahaṃ svayaṃ brahma na kiñcidasti matparaṃ vijṛmbheta yadā sphuṭaṃ citiḥ | itīha māyāsamayopapāditaṃ niranvayaṃ suvrata mā sma viśvasīḥ || 4.10|| yadetadātmaikyamupāsticoditaṃ na me gurorapyaparokṣatāṃ gatam‌ | purātanānāmapi saumya kutracit‌ tato mukundaṃ bhaja saṃvide mudā || 4.11|| itīdamādiśya vaco vacasvini svake gurau lokamathānyamīyuṣi | asevatālocya muhurgurorgiraṃ sa rūpyapīṭhālayamindirāvaram‌ || 4.12|| subhaktinā tena sa bhaktavatsalo niṣevitastatra paraṃ bubhutsunā | bhaviṣyataḥ śiṣyavarāddhi viddhi māmiti praviṣṭaḥ puruṣaṃ tamabhyadhāt‌ || 4.13|| pratīkṣamāṇaṃ tamanugrahaṃ mudā niṣevamāṇaṃ punarambujekṣaṇam‌ | satāṃ guruḥ kāraṇamānuṣākṛtiryatiṃ praśāntaṃ tamupāsasāda saḥ || 4.14|| sutaṃ yatīndrānucaraṃ virāgiṇaṃ niśamya saṅnyāsanibaddhamānasam‌ | suvatsalau rūpyatalālayasthitaṃ viyogatāntau pitarau samīyatuḥ || 4.15|| varāśramaste jaratoranāthayorna jīvatoḥ syādayi nandanāvayoḥ | sayācanaṃ vākyamudīrya tāvidaṃ parītya putrāya natiṃ vitenatuḥ || 4.16|| natirna śuśrūṣujanāya śasyate nataṃ bhavadbhyāṃ sphuṭamatra sāmpratam‌ | aho vidhātrā svayameva dāpitā tadabhyanujñeti jagāda sa prabhuḥ || 4.17|| anuttarajñaḥ sa tamarthayan‌ punaḥ yatīndramānamya gataḥ priyāyutaḥ | gṛhe vasan‌ kalpasamān‌ kṣaṇānnayan‌ sutānanendoraniśaṃ tato'smarat‌ | 18|| sa cintayan‌ putramanorathaṃ śucā punaśca tīrthvopagato mahānadīm‌ | vratīśvarānuvratamātmanandanaṃ tamaikṣata grāmavare maṭhāntare || 4.19|| sañjātakopākulito dharāsuro mahātmanāṃ laṅghanabhīrurapyalam‌ | sutasya kaupīnadhṛtau hi sāhasapratiśravo me dṛḍha ityabhāṣata || 4.20|| kṣaṇena kaupīnadharo nijaṃ paṭaṃ vidārya he tāta kuruṣva sāhasam‌ | itīmamuktvā vibhurabravīt‌ punaḥ śubhāntarāyaṃ na bhavāṃścarediti || 4.21|| na putra pitroravanaṃ vinā śubhaṃ vadanti santo nanu tau sutau mṛtau | nivartamāne na hi pālako'sti nau tvayīti vaktāramamuṃ suto'bravīt‌ || 4.22|| yadā viraktaḥ puruṣaḥ prajāyate tadaiva sanyāsavidhiḥ śrutau śrutaḥ | na saṅgahīno'pi parivrajāmi vāmahaṃ tu śuśrūṣumakalpayanniti || 4.23|| bahuśrutatvādyadi tatsahe balānna sā savitrī virahaṃ saheta te | iti dvijenābhihite'namat‌ sa taṃ bhavānanujñāṃ pradadātviti bruvan‌ || 4.24|| vicintya vidvān‌ sa niruttarīkṛtastathā'stu mātā'nuvadedyadīti tam‌ | udīrya kṛcchrādupagamya mandiraṃ priyāsakāśe tamudantamabravīt‌ || 4.25|| niśācarāreriva lakṣmaṇaḥ purā vṛkodarasyeva surendranandanaḥ | gado'tha śaureriva karmakṛt‌ priyaḥ subhaktimān‌ viśvavido'nujo'bhavat‌ || 4.26|| kadācidāpyālayabuddhirālayaṃ nivedayan‌ pālakamenametayoḥ | dṛḍhasvasaṃnyāsaniṣedhaniścayāṃ dhavānumatyedamuvāca mātaram‌ || 4.27|| varāśramāptiṃ mama saṃvadasva māṃ kadācidapyamba yadīcchasīkṣitum‌ | yadanyathā deśamimaṃ parityajan‌ na jātu dṛṣṭerviṣayo bhavāmi vaḥ || 4.28|| iti bruvāṇe tanaye kadācidapyadarśanaṃ tasya mṛternidarśanam‌ | vicintya paryākulitā cikīrṣitaṃ sutasya kṛcchrānnayaruṇanna sā śubhā || 4.29|| athopagamyaiṣa guruṃ jagadguruḥ prasādya taṃ devavaraprasāditaḥ | sadā samastāśramabhāk‌ sureśvaro viśeṣataḥ khalvabhajadvarāśramam‌ || 4.30|| kriyākalāpaṃ sakalaṃ sa kālavidvidhānamārgeṇa vidhāya kevalam‌ | sadā prasannasya hareḥ prasattaye muhuḥ samastanyasanaṃ samabhyadhāt‌ || 4.31|| anantamātrāntamudāharanti yaṃ trimātrapūrvaṃ praṇavoccayaṃ budhāḥ | tadā'bhavadbhāvicaturmukhākṛtirjapādhikārī yatirasya sūcitaḥ | 32|| guṇānurūponnatipūrṇabodha ityamuṣya nāma dvijavṛndavanditaḥ | udāharad‌ bhūriyaśā hi kevalaṃ na mantravarṇaḥ sa ca mantravarṇakaḥ || 4.33|| niraṅgarāgaṃ mukharāgavarjitaṃ vibhūṣaṇaṃ viṣṭapabhūṣaṇāyitam‌ | amuṃ dhṛtāṣāḍhamavekṣya menire svabhāvaśobhā'nupameti jantavaḥ || 4.34|| bhujaṅgabhūteśavihaṅgapādikaiḥ pravanditaḥ sāvasarapratīkṣaṇaiḥ | nanāma so'yaṃ gurupūrvakān‌ yatīnaho mahīyo mahatāṃ viḍambanam‌ || 4.35|| varāśramācāraviśeṣaśikṣaṇaṃ vidhitsurasyācaritaṃ niśāmayan‌ | viśeṣaśikṣāṃ svayamāpya dhīradhīḥ yatīśvaro vismayamāyatāntaram‌ || 4.36|| sa raupyapīṭhālayavāsine yadā nanāma nāthāya mahāmatirmudā | tadā'munā'grāhi narapraveśinā bhuje bhujenāśu bhujaṅgaśāyinā || 4.37|| cirāt‌ sutattavaṃ prabubhutsunā tvayā niṣevaṇaṃ me yadakāri tatphalam‌ | amuṃ dadāmītyabhidhāya so'munā tadā praṇīya pradade'cyutātmane || 4.38|| anugrahaṃ taṃ pratigṛhya sādaraṃ mudā''tmanā''ptāṃ kṛtakṛtyatāṃ smaran‌ | abhūdasaṅgo'pi sa tatsusaṅgavānasaṅgabhūṣā nanu sādhusaṅgitā || 4.39|| yiyāsati svastaṭinīṃ muhurmuhurnamatyanujñārthini bhūricetasi | tamasmarat‌ svāminameva dūnadhīrgururbhaviṣyadvirahāgniśaṅkayā || 4.40|| itastṛtīye divase dyunimnagā tvadarthamāsmākataṭākamāvrajet‌ | ato na yāyā iti taṃ tadā'vadat‌ praviśya kañcit‌ karuṇākaro hariḥ || 4.41|| tadājñayopāgatajāhnavījale jano'tra sasnau saha pūrṇabuddhinā | tataḥ paraṃ dvādaśavatsarāntare sadā''vrajet‌ sā tadanugrahāṅkinī || 4.42|| gate dinānāṃ daśake samāsake varāśramaṃ prāpya sapatralambanam‌ | jigāya jaitrān‌ bahutarkakarkaśān‌ sa vāsudevāhvayapaṇḍitādikān‌ || 4.43|| guroḥ svaśiṣyaṃ caturaṃ cikīrṣataḥ pracodanācchrotumihopacakrame | atheṣṭasiddhiśchalajātivāridhirnirādareṇāpi mahātmanā'munā || 4.44|| tadādyapadyasthamavadyamaṇḍalaṃ yadā'vadat‌ ṣoḍaśakadvayātmakam‌ | uparyapāstaṃ taditi bruvatyasau gurau tamūce praṇigadyatāmiti || 4.45|| bhavatpravaktṛtvasamarthatā na me sakopamitthaṃ bruvati vratīśvare | apīha māyāsamaye paṭau nṛṇāṃ babhūva tad‌dūṣaṇasaṃśayāṅkuraḥ || 4.46|| budho'bhidhānaṃ śravaṇaṃ budhetaro dhruvaṃ vidadhyādvimumukṣurātmanaḥ | yatirviśeṣāditi lokacodanāt‌ pravakti māyāsamayaṃ sma pūrṇadhīḥ || 4.47|| akhaṇḍitopanyasanaṃ visaṃśayaṃ sasampradāyaṃ pravaco dṛḍhottaram‌ | samāgamañchrotumamuṣya sāgrahā janāḥ śrutāḍhyāścaturā bubhūṣavaḥ || 4.48|| gurorupānte śravaṇe ratairdvijaiḥ sapañcaṣairbhāgavate kadācana | bahuprakāre likhite tu vācite prakāramekaṃ prabhurabhyadhād‌ dṛḍham‌ || 4.49|| paraprakāreṣvapi sambhavatsu te vinirṇayo'smin‌ kathamityudīrite | mukundabodhena mahāhṛdabravīt‌ prakāramekaṃ bhagavatkṛtaṃ sphuṭam‌ || 4.50|| nigadyatāṃ gadyamihaiva pañcame jagadgurorvettha kṛtisthitiṃ yadi | iti bruvāṇe yatisattame svayaṃ taduktamārgeṇa jagāda bhūrihṛt‌ || 4.51|| aśeṣaśiṣyaiśca tadājñayā tadā parīkṣaṇāyaikṣi samastapustakam‌ | sa tatra hantaikatamesthitaṃ tyajan‌ na tāvadadhyāyanikāyamabhyadhāt‌ || 4.52|| atra janmani na yatpaṭhitaṃ te jaitra bhāti kathamityamunokte | pūrvajanmasu hi veda puredaṃ sarvamityamitabuddhiruvāca || 4.53|| iti bahuvidhaviśvāścaryacittapravṛtteḥ jagati vitatimāyannūtanā'pyasya kīrtiḥ kṣapitatatatamaskā bhāskarīva prabhā'laṃ sujanakumudavṛndānandadā candrikeva || 4.54|| iti śrīmatkavikulatilaka trivikramapaṇḍitācāryasuta nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācāryaviracite śrīmatsumadhvavijaye mahākāvye ānandāṅke caturthaḥ sargaḥ <5> pañcamaḥ sargaḥ vedāntavidyānijarājyapālane saṅkalpyamāno guruṇā garīyasi | adabhracetā abhiṣicyate purā sa vāribhirvārijapūritairatha || 5.1|| ānandarūpasya parasya pātradhīrānandasandāyisuśāstrakṛt‌ sa yat‌ | ānandatīrtheti padaṃ gurūditaṃ babhūva tasyātyanurūparūpakam‌ || 5.2|| kadācidatropayayau yatiḥ sakhā govindabuddherbahuśiṣyasaṃvṛtaḥ | amuṣya śiṣyā anumānaśikṣitāstadā'jigīṣan‌ gurubuddhimuddhatāḥ || 5.3|| bhidā susādhyetyanumānamatra taiḥ prāyujyatāśu pratipakṣabhīṣaṇam‌ | akhaṇḍayadvyaktamakhaṇḍadhīridaṃ sa pakṣadakṣaḥ phaṇinaṃ virāḍiva || 5.4|| athāpi mithyā vimataṃ matatvato vivādanirmuktavadityavādi taiḥ | anena satyaṃ vimataṃ matattavato yathā ghaṭādītyanumā nyagadyata || 5.5|| hetorativyāptiravādi tairyadā sakautukaistūrṇamasāvavismayaḥ | na śuktirūpyādi mataṃ yadanyathāmataṃ tadityādi vadan‌ jigāya tān‌ || 5.6|| tattave'pyatattave vimate'numāṃ vadan‌ tadapratiṣṭhāṃ pratipādukaḥ svayam‌ | vijitya viśvān‌ viduṣaḥ sabhāsvasau jagāma nāmnā'pyanumānatīrthatām‌ || 5.7|| samastavādīndragajaprabhaṅgadaścarannavanyāṃ pratipakṣakāṅkṣayā | vedadviṣāṃ yaḥ prathamaḥ samāyayau savādisiṃho'tra sa buddhisāgaraḥ || 5.8|| tasyorudurgarvavato jigīṣayā niśātamādatta mukundadhīdrutam‌ | svaśiṣyahastena maṭhāntareṣudheḥ supakṣadakṣaṃ sukhatīrthamārgaṇam‌ || 5.9|| jaitraṃ pratijñāsu kutūhalākulaṃ nṛṇāṃ kulaṃ pratvaritaṃ niśāmayan‌ | avandatopetya guruṃ gariṣṭhadhīḥ sa rūpyapīṭhāyatanottamasthitam‌ || 5.10|| sa vādisiṃhasya giraṃ garīyasīmakhaṇḍayat‌ paṇḍitamaṇḍalāntare | tīkṣṇena vākyena mitena veginā gadāṃ śareṇeva viśārado muhuḥ || 5.11|| asāvasūyan‌ dvinavaprakārato vyacīklṛpat‌ kañcidathārthamuccakaiḥ | jagadvijetuśca jaye sasaṃśayastāvajjano'jāyata pūrṇacetasaḥ || 5.12|| vikalpakoṭīratha khaṇḍayan‌ drutaṃ reje'dhikaṃ smeramukho bṛhanmatiḥ | tamastatīrvā dyumaṇirviśuddhayā gavā śrito viṣṇupadaṃ sadāspadam‌ || 5.13|| agādhamātmanyativelamuddhataṃ tiraskṛtāśeṣasarasvatītatim‌ | kāmaṃ mahāmānasakumbhasambhavo laghūcakāretyapi buddhisāgaram‌ || 5.14|| śva eva vādo'stviti vādinau khalāvadyottaraṃ bhāti yadīryatāmiti | madhve bruvāṇe'mata tau jitau janaḥ sa niścikāyātha niśāpalāyanāt‌ || 5.15|| buddhyabdhinā vādivareṇa cārjitāṃ jayaśriyaṃ bhūparivartinā cirāt‌ | aho muhūrtādayamaprayatnavānavāptavānityativismitaṃ janaiḥ || 5.16|| vyākhyan‌ kadācinmaṇimadvinirmitaṃ bhāṣyaṃ janaistarkaviśāradairvṛtaḥ | uvāca vācaṃ parihāsahāsavān‌ sammodatīrthaḥ suramodadāyinīm‌ || 5.17|| satsūtrabhāve pravicārite pṛthagbhāṣyābhisandhau ca viśuddhabuddhibhiḥ | nigṛhya gūḍhāgrahamugrametayormānyo'nvayo'nyonyamaho na dṛśyate || 5.18|| iti bruvāṇe pratipādayatyalaṃ bhāṣye'tra doṣān‌ prabalān‌ muhurmuhuḥ | tasmiṃstu vismeradhiyo'pi yatnato na stheyasaḥ paryaharannimānamī || 5.19|| nanvasya sūtrasya paro'rtha ucyatāṃ yadbhāṣyamātraṃ bhavatā nirasyate | bhavādṛśairyaḥ kavibhirna dūṣyate kathañcanetyūcurime vacasvinaḥ || 5.20|| akliṣṭaśabdānvayameṣa sambhavatsūtrārthamuccairvacanaṃ tadādade | mānīkṛtāmnāyayutasmṛti kṣaṇādeṣyatkathātāṇḍavasūtradhārakam‌ || 5.21|| bubhutsayā matsaravarjitān‌ janān‌ samatsarān‌ vā vijigīṣayā''gatān‌ | śrutapravīṇānatitārkikān‌ muhurbhaṅgyā'nayā bhaṅgamupānināya saḥ || 5.22|| kadācidenaṃ pratigamya saumyadhīḥ sa madhyagehāryavaraḥ prasedivān‌ | hetoḥ kutaścidvimanīkṛto'pyaho guṇābdhilubdhaḥ sujanaḥ prasīdati || 5.23|| tejo'mṛtaṃ nandanagātrapātragaṃ netrāñjalibhyāmapibat‌ sadā'vyayam‌ | vidyāsudhāṃ cāsya vacomahāghaṭe pūrṇāmasau karṇapuṭena paṇḍitaḥ || 5.24|| līlāvivāde guruṇā jagad‌guroḥ prasaṅgatastatra ca tādṛśe sati | sūtrārthaviccet‌ kurubhāṣyamañjasetyākṣepapūrvaṃ gururabhyadhādimam‌ || 5.25|| vidhānamātraṃ tadupādade tadā payo yathācchaṃ paramaḥ sa haṃsarāṭ‌ | tallīnamākṣepamupaikṣatāphalaṃ vārīva santo hi guṇāṃśatoṣiṇaḥ || 5.26|| vairāgyavaiyātyasuvāktvapūrvakairyukto guṇaiḥ pāramahaṃsyabhūṣaṇaiḥ | jyeṣṭho yatiryo likucānvayodbhavastaṃ bhūribhaktiḥ sa kadācidabravīt‌ || 5.27|| virodhi vedāntakṛtāntasampadāṃ bhāṣyādikaṃ cedidamastu kā kṣatiḥ | asmabhyamācakṣva vicakṣaṇocitaṃ bhāvaṃ tu sūtropaniṣadvivakṣitam‌ || 5.28|| ityasya vācā śaradeva bhāsitā yadā'khilāśā śubhapūrṇayā babhau | pramodatīrthānanacandracandrikā vyākhyābhidhā viṣṇupadaprakāśinī || 5.29|| jeṣyan‌ kadācit‌ kila kālapālitāṃ diśaṃ prayāto'cyutabuddhinā saha | samagradhīrmaṇḍitaviṣṇumaṅgalaṃ viṣṇuṃ jaganmaṅgalamānanāma saḥ || 5.30|| bhikṣāpradātrā'tra parīkṣituṃ muhurdatte prabhukte kadalīphaloccaye | anena niryatnamavāryavismayastamāryavaryaṃ vijane'vadad‌ guruḥ || 5.31|| bhikṣāvasāne dviśatādhikaiḥ phalairvyūḍhaiḥ prabhuktaiḥ paripūrite'pi te | tanūdare nāsti gariṣṭhatā kathaṃ sucitta satyaṃ vadatādbhavāniti || 5.32|| aṅguṣṭhamātraṃ jaṭhare pratiṣṭhitaṃ jājvalyamānaṃ mama jātavedasam‌ | nityaṃ hitaṃ viśvadahaṃ ca vitta taṃ viśveśacetā iti so'bravīt‌ tadā || 5.33|| paryākulānekasarasvatītatīn‌ nyāyopapannān‌ vividhārthasaṃyutān‌ | atītya deśān‌ samayāṃśca cārudhīrasau jagāmābhimatena vartmanā || 5.34|| svahelayā pātitapārthivavrajāṃ dhīśuddhidāṃ keralabhūṣaṇāyitām‌ | payasvinīṃ prekṣya pathi dvijārcitāṃ sa bhāvinīmasmaradatra caṇḍikām‌ || 5.35|| tataḥ krameṇa pracalannupeyivānavandatendīvarasundaracchavim‌ | ambhojanābhaṃ sa bhujaṅgaśāyinaṃ śrīvallabhaṃ śrīmadanantasatpure || 5.36|| vedāntasūtrāṇi kṛtāntavittamo vyākhyādasau śiṣyagaṇāya saṃsadi | vilakṣaṇaṃ jīvagaṇād‌ guṇārṇavaṃ brahmācyutākhyaṃ pratipādayan‌ muhuḥ || 5.37|| aprāṃśunūtnopapadādhivāsajaḥ sa saṅkaro vairaparāyaṇaḥ punaḥ | asūyayoce'tra mahānatikramaḥ sūtrārthavādo'kṛtabhāṣyakeṣviti || 5.38|| vadottaraṃ bhāti yadīha kurmahe bhāṣyaṃ kṛtirnāsya hi daṇḍavāritā | jagad‌gurūṇāmiti tāṃ gurorgiraṃ janaḥ samasto'bhinananda sasmitām‌ || 5.39|| prājñairmahāpūruṣasarvalakṣaṇaiḥ sampannadeho'yamitīrite prabhau | pare parasyāpyatipīnatādṛśaḥ sphiṅmātrasaṃśaṃsanamatra cakrire || 5.40|| sphigdūṣaṇāni pratipādayatyalaṃ sampūrṇasaṅkhye'sya tu lakṣmaśāstrataḥ | taddaṇḍasaṅkhaṇḍanasaṃśravaṃ vyadhāt‌ tadakṣamo'sau prakṛtirhi sā'satām‌ || 5.41|| snātvā'tra tīrtheṣvacireṇa kanyakātīrthe sutīrthe sukhatīrtha āplutaḥ | samudrasetau ca nimajya viṣṇave śrīrāmanāthāya namaścakāra saḥ || 5.42|| tamāvrajantaṃ yativeṣamāsuraṃ (yativeṣadhāriṇaṃ) daṇḍaṃ prakāśyaiṣa hasannabhāṣata | khaṇḍyeta daṇḍo yadi caṇḍa na tvayā tvaṃ ṣaṇḍhako'paṇḍita vandhyavāgiti || 5.43|| lajjānataḥ svārthamathārthayannasannupaikṣatāsau dvijanāyakaistadā | ānandayantaṃ vadanendunā jagat‌ taṃ dveṣṭi kaḥ prājñamiheti vādibhiḥ || 5.44|| yā yāḥ prasaktāḥ pariṣatsu pūruṣairvidyāvidagdhairvividhaiḥ samāgame | sa tāsu tāsu pratibhāti bhāsuro vidyāsu vidyādhipatirjigāya tān‌ || 5.45|| acālyamānaḥ sa guruḥ sa cāpalairasajjanānāmabalīyasāmiha | uvāsa māsāṃścaturo mahāmanāḥ siṃho guhāntopagataḥ śunāmiva || 5.46|| śṛṅgārasindhuṃ sa bhujaṅgaśāyinaṃ śrīraṅgavāsaṃ kṛtamaṅgalaṃ satām‌ | amandadhīrdevamavandatāgataḥ kaverakanyāhimavāyusevitam‌ || 5.47|| tato nivṛttaḥ parameva pūruṣaṃ praṇamya nānāyataneṣu sañcaran‌ | prakāśayan‌ svātiśayānamānuṣānāśāmudīcīṃ prayayāvasau kramāt‌ || 5.48|| tatastato vismitalocanairnarairnirīkṣyamāṇo'tisulakṣaṇākṛtiḥ | grāmottamān‌ prāpya payasvinītaṭe viveśa devāyatanaṃ sa kiñcana || 5.49|| adhītya dharmeṇa ṣaḍaṅgamāgamaṃ tadarthasaṃvarṇananirṇayānvitāḥ | prāpurdvijendrāstamapūrvapūruṣaṃ jijñāsavaḥ suprathitaṃ jagattaraye || 5.50|| susmitendumaravindalocanaṃ svarṇavarṇamatibhadrabhāṣaṇam‌ | vītabhūṣamapi viśvabhūṣaṇaṃ taṃ didṛkṣuralamāpatajjanaḥ || 5.51|| vidyorudyutidhīratārakatiraskāre pataṅgāyito durvādībhakutarkakumbhadalane siṃhaprabarhāyitaḥ | lolālokakalokadṛkkumudinīsaṃhlādane'bjāyitaḥ saṃsanmaṇḍalamaṇḍanāyitavapuḥ svānandatīrtho babhau || 5.52|| iti śrīmatkavikulatilaka trivikramapaṇḍitācāryasuta nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācāryaviracite śrīmatsumadhvavijaye mahākāvye ānandāṅke pañcamaḥ sargaḥ <6> ṣaṣṭhaḥ sargaḥ aitareyamatha kiñcana sūktaṃ sūcayan‌ sadasi tatra gariṣṭhaḥ | śrotumicchati sabhā bhagavadbhyaḥ sūktabhāvamiti tāvaduvāca || 6.1|| varṇasauṣṭhavagariṣṭhamatūrṇaṃ tulyamātramatimātrasulakṣma | vyūḍhahṛjjaladaghoṣamamuṣyoccāraṇaṃ vidadhadabhyadhitārtham‌ || 6.2|| lakṣaṇānvitatayā vacane'smin‌ devatāgurumasāvatiśete | mānamityapi vidhāya dhiyā te tattu sūktamaparārthamavocan‌ || 6.3|| syāt‌ tathetthamapi sambhavitārthastryarthatāṃ śrutiṣu vitta daśārtham‌ | bhārataṃ nanu śatārthamapi syādvaiṣṇavaṃ padasahasratayaṃ hi || 6.4|| ityudīrayati vistṛtacitte bhūsurā iha jigīṣava enam‌ | ūcurarthaśatakaṃ harināmnāṃ varṇyatāmiti sahāsamukhāste || 6.5|| varṇayāmi tadahaṃ sakalaṃ vaḥ sauṣṭhavādanuvadantu bhavantaḥ | taṃ vadantamiti te'tha vadanto bāḍhamityatidṛḍhodyamamāpuḥ || 6.6|| pratyayaprakṛtisaṅgamabhaṅgīṃ śabdaśāstravihitāṃ pratidṛṣya (pratidarśya) | śuddhadhīḥ śrutiśiraḥśatasiddhānabhyadhāt‌ sapadi viśvapadārthān‌ || 6.7|| yāvadarthaśatakaṃ na viśaṅkaḥ santatoktikṛdapūrayadeṣaḥ | varṇitāvadhṛtidurbalacittāstāvadākulahṛdo hyabhavaṃste || 6.8|| sāṅgavedacaturā itihāse śikṣitāḥ subahavo'pyatidhṛṣṭāḥ | naitadīritamaho jagṛhuste viśvasaṅkṣayapayo'ndhugaṇā vā || 6.9|| devatāsvasulabhā pratibhā te mānuṣeṣu capaleṣu kathā kā | kṣāmya saumya sakalajña namaste te bruvanta iti taṃ kila nemuḥ || 6.10|| vedaśāstracaturairiha vidyāvittalipsubhiravāptamaśeṣaiḥ | prāpa keralasumaṇḍalajātairanyadāyatanamāyatacetāḥ || 6.11|| tarkatantrakuśalānapi puṃsaścarkarīti bata so'yamamānān‌ | mānamānamayatīha kathaṃ no naiṣamaṇḍalabhuvāṃ samitānām‌ || 6.12|| mantrayanta iti te dvijavaryā anyadeśajamukhāstamapṛcchan‌ | saddadādadasuśaṃsananindākārisūktagatamarthamupetya || 6.13|| taṃ sphuṭaṃ prakaṭayan‌ (prakathayan‌) sa pṛṇīyācchabdamūlamavadat‌ pṛṇadhātum‌ | taṃ jigīṣumatha vipramadaḥ prīṅ‌dhātumeṣa || 6.17|| śvitriṇī bhavati tatpadavācyetyāgraheṇa vadato viduṣo'tra | kaścideṣyati vipaścidihainaṃ pṛcchatetyayamagacchadathoktvā || 6.18|| deśamenamacirādupayātastādṛśākṛtiraho kṛtabuddhiḥ | hetuvādini viśaṅkaṭabuddhau tīrthamarthayati gantumanujñām‌ | tāṃ dideśa puruṣottamatīrthaścintayan‌ sa puruṣottamarakṣām‌ || 6.33|| nīrajā malayamaṇḍalavṛttayā ślāghito bhuvi sadālyanuyātaḥ | vāsudevapadasantatasaṅgī tejasā'pyalamadhaḥkṛtaśarvaḥ | atyavartata nitāntamathāsau gāṅgamoghamaghanāśanakīrtiḥ || 6.36|| tatra tatra sa jagatrayacitraṃ karma śarmadamanusmṛtimātrāt‌ | sañcaran‌ vidadhadāpa narāṇāṃ gocaraṃ badarikāśramapārśvam‌ || 6.37|| maṇḍayan‌ bharatakhaṇḍamakhaṇḍaṃ nādirāyaṇapado'tra paro yaḥ | taṃ naman‌ pracuradhīrharigītābhāṣyamārpayadupāyanamasmai || 6.38|| prītaye'sya purato varabhāṣyaṃ vācayan‌ sa janatāmapasārya | vacmi śaktita urukramagītābhāvamityakathayat‌ purusaṅkhyaḥ || 6.39|| etadarthamapi sūkṣmamapi tvaṃ śakta eva na yadāttha samastam‌ | tena leśata itīha padaṃ syādityagadyata jagajjanakena || 6.40|| tena tatpravacane vihite'laṃ śuśruvuḥ praśayitā api śiṣyāḥ | ucyatāmiti muhuḥ sapṛthivyāsphālanaṃ padamaho hariṇoktam‌ || 6.41|| śabdabhedamavadhārya tamarcāsanniṣaṇṇavapuṣaḥ paramasya | tasya bhāvavidadabhramanīṣaḥ protthitaḥ pravacanaṃ vyadhitaibhyaḥ || 6.42|| majjanaṃ vyadhita śītalagaṅgāvāri nityamaruṇodayakāle | yat‌ spṛśanti na narā himabhītā aṃśa eṣa pṛṣatāmadhipasya || 6.43|| kāṣṭhamaunamadadhādupavāsaṃ śuddhamapyakṛta śuddhahṛdicchan‌ | nityatuṣṭaharitoṣaviśeṣaṃ cintyayan‌ prabhumanantamaṭhāntaḥ || 6.44|| prairayat‌ svacaraṇe ratacittaṃ madhvamatra dinamaṇḍalamenam‌ | svāśramopagamanāya mukundo dīptidṛṣṭividitāgatiranyaiḥ || 6.45|| naktameva bhagavatyupayāte prodite sati sahasramarīcau | maunavānalikhaduttamacittaḥ śiṣyaśikṣaṇaparaḥ karuṇāvān‌ || 6.46|| nedṛśaṃ sthalamalaṃ śamalaghnaṃ nāsya tīrthasalilasya samaṃ vāḥ | nāsti viṣṇusadṛśaṃ nanu daivaṃ nāsmaduktisadṛśaṃ hitarūpam‌ || 6.47|| yāti tāvadadhunaiva jano'yaṃ vyāsarūpamajitaṃ pradidṛkṣuḥ | āvrajediha na vā sa hi veda svasti vo'stviti yayāvatha madhvaḥ || 6.48|| nātha nātha bata no'tra vināthān‌ mā tyajorukaruṇo bhagavaṃstvam‌ | noditaṃ smṛtamapīti hi śiṣyaiḥ svāmino'bhimatabhaṅgabhayena || 6.49|| sad‌gurorna virahaṃ sahamānaḥ satyatīrthayatiranvagamat‌ tam‌ | yastrivāramitarāsutaśākhāsvarthamagryamaśṛṇot‌ purusaṅkhyāt‌ || 6.50|| durgamārgagatamapyanudhāvan‌ nāpa so'yamaruṇībhavatīne | līlayā sajavamākramamāṇaṃ vyāśrayāntarasudūraśilāsu || 6.51|| ānivṛttavapuṣā guruṇā''rāt‌ pāṇinā hyabhinayena sununnaḥ | trastadhīratiyayau sa muhūrtāt‌ taddinopagatamārgamaśeṣam‌ || 6.52|| āśrame nijajanāniha dṛṣṭvā taṃ prasādamahimānamamuṣya | procya tatplavanamapyaticitraṃ tasya taiḥ saha sadā'smaradeṣaḥ || 6.53|| || 6.56|| pādopāntanamanmahāmunigaṇaṃ hemapradīptāmbaram‌ | śrīmadratnakalāpamagryakaṭakairvibhrājitaṃ hāṭakaiḥ | dṛṣṭvā taṃ dharaṇīdharaṃ suvanamālollāsinaṃ sundaram‌ | svānandākṛtimasmaranmuraripuṃ svānandatīrthastadā || 6.57|| iti śrīmatkavikulatilaka trivikramapaṇḍitācāryasuta nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācāryaviracite śrīmatsumadhvavijaye mahākāvye ānandāṅke ṣaṣṭhaḥ sargaḥ <7> saptamaḥ sargaḥ atha || 7.8|| caturaścaturānanaḥ svayaṃ pavano vā vratirūpa āvrajan‌ | śrutināthadidṛkṣayā'nyathā na khalu syānnikhilāgryalakṣmavān‌ || 7.9|| avalokitalakṣaṇaḥ sa tairiti sañcintya kutūhalākulaiḥ | aticitravicitrapatriṇaṃ bahuvarṇaṃ harigonivārakam‌ | muninandanamindirāpateradhikeṣṭaṃ patatāmivādhipam‌ || 7.12|| amṛtātmamahāphalapradaṃ duravāpaṃ haribhaktivarjitaiḥ | śritasādhupurāṇabhārataṃ nigamaṃ mūrtamivoruśākhinam‌ || 7.13|| atha tasya sa vedikāntare suviśāle vimale manohare | avalokitavānanantadhīrdivi devāniva tāpasottamān‌ || 7.14|| api saptatayā virājitān‌ gatasaṅkhyān‌ guṇino guṇojhjhitān‌ | api manyumadādivarjitān‌ gatabhogān‌ pavanāśanān‌ sadā || 7.15|| munimaṇḍalamadhyavartinaṃ trijaganmaṇḍalamaṇḍanāyitam‌ | iha satyavatīsutaṃ hariṃ paripūrṇapramatiḥ samaikṣata || 7.16|| nijahṛtkamale'tinirmale satataṃ sādhu niśāmayannapi | avalokya punaḥ punarnavaṃ tamasau vismita ityacintayat‌ || 7.17|| agaṇeyaguṇārṇavo (agaṇayyaguṇārṇavo)'malaḥ sa hi nārāyaṇa eṣa kevalam‌ | vidhinā'nusṛtaṃ parāśarāt‌ suṣuve satyavatī kilātra yam‌ || 7.18|| dhavale'sya manaḥpayonidhau sadanukrośagirīndralolite | prakaṭībhavati sma sundarī dayitā daityaripostrayīmayī || 7.19|| ita eva purāṇagauragau samahābhāratapārijātake | sati jātavati vyajāyata pravaraṃ sūtragaṇāmṛtaṃ svayam‌ || 7.20|| niravagrahamurvanugrahaṃ vidadhat‌ pāṇḍusutādisajjane | avanāvavanāya saṃvidāṃ sucirāyaiṣa paramājinayogapīṭhagaṃ mama cetonayanābhinandanam‌ || 7.23|| agaṇeyaguṇaiḥ supūritaṃ paripūrṇāgaṇitātmasadguṇaiḥ | idamastasamastadūṣaṇaṃ sacidānandamayaṃ hi kevalam‌ || 7.24|| kamalākamalāsanānilairvihagāhīndraśivendrapūrvakaiḥ | padapadmarajo'sya dhāritaṃ śirasā hanta vahāmyahaṃ muhuḥ || 7.25|| praṇamāmi padadvayaṃ vibhordhvajavajrāṅkuśapadmacihnavat‌ | nijamānasarāgapīḍanādaruṇībhūtamivāruṇaṃ svayam‌ || 7.26|| nanu kevalameva vaiṣṇavaṃ śritavantaḥ padamātmarociṣā | tamaso'pyubhayasya nāśakā vijayante nakharā navaṃ ravim‌ || 7.27|| sukumāratalāṅgulīmatoḥ padayorasya nigūḍhagulphayoḥ | upamānamaho na dṛśyate kavivaryairitaretaraṃ vinā || 7.28|| ucitāṃ gurutāṃ dadhat‌ kramācchuci tejasvi suvṛttamuttamam‌ | bhajato'tra ca rucirājadyuticārurociṣā | paramorunitambasaṅginā paramāścaryatayā virājate || 7.31|| tanunimnasunābhiśobhite valibhe vārijanābha ādadhe | pratanāvatisundare mṛdāvudare'smin‌ jagadaṇḍamaṇḍalam‌ || 7.32|| hṛdaye kṛtasajjanodaye suviśāle munivaṃśaśekharaḥ | ubhayaṃ vahati trayīmayaṃ vimalaṃ brahmasusūtramuttamam‌ || 7.33|| asame'nadhike susādhite nijatāte ravirāśidīdhiti | pradadau gurorgalaḥ || 7.37|| sakalāstakalaṅkakālimasphuradinduprakaroruvibhramam‌ | adharīkurute svaśobhayā vadanaṃ devaśikhāmaṇeridam‌ || 7.38|| aruṇāśmadalāntarollasannavamuktāvalimasya lajjayet‌ | hasataḥ sitadantasantatiḥ paramaśrīraruṇoṣṭharociṣaḥ || 7.39|| dvijavṛndakṛtaṃ kutūhalād‌ (mahādarād‌) anuyogāndhusahasramuttamam‌ | iyamekapade sarasvatī śrutibhartuḥ paripūrayatyaho || 7.40|| jalajāyatalocanasya māmavaloko'yamupetya lālayan‌ | kurute parirabhya pūritaṃ bhuvanānandakarasmitānvitaḥ || 7.41|| upakarṇamamuṣya bhāsitā tulasī mantrayatīva lālitā | mama nāthapadaṃ na matsarājjalajādyāni hareyurityalam‌ || 7.42|| vibhavābhibhavodbhavādikaṃ bhuvanānāṃ bhuvanaprabhorbhruvoḥ | anayorapi dabhravibhramāt‌ sabhavāmbhojabhavātmanāṃ bhavet‌ || 7.43|| trijagattilakālikāntare tilako'yaṃ parabhāgamāptavān‌ | harinīlagirīndramastakasphuṭaśoṇopalapaṅktisannibhaḥ || 7.44|| navamambudharaṃ viḍambayadvaravidyudvalayaṃ jagadguroḥ | avalokya kṛtārthatāmagāṃ sajaṭāmaṇḍalamaṇḍanaṃ vapuḥ || 7.45|| na ramāpi padāṅgulīlasannakhadhūrājadanantasadguṇān‌ | gaṇayedgaṇayantyanārataṃ paramān‌ (matimān‌) ko'sya paro guṇān‌ vadet‌ || 7.46|| na kutūhalitā kutūhalaṃ tanumenāmavalokya sad‌guroḥ | sanavāvaraṇāṇḍadarśino gṛhabuddhyā mama niṣkutūhalam‌ || 7.47|| iti cintayatā mahādhiyā padavīṃ bāhyagatāmatīyuṣā | samanonayanaiḥ purāgatastata āpe vapuṣā'pi vedarāṭ‌ || 7.48|| gurubhaktibharānatākṛtirviracayyāñjalibandhamañjasā | kṣaṇamāmukulīkṛtekṣaṇaḥ sa guruṃ kevalamabhyavandata || 7.49|| vinayābharaṇena bhūṣitaḥ sphuṭamaṣṭāṅgaviśiṣṭaceṣṭitaḥ | bhagavattamapādapaṅkaje bhagavān‌ sa praṇanāma bhāgyavān‌ || 7.50|| sa nirīkṣya parāśarātmajaḥ praṇataṃ preṣṭhamaśeṣasadguṇaiḥ | karayoryugalena valgunā tamudasthāpayadāśupātinā || 7.51|| amitapramatiṃ śrutīśvaraḥ parirebhe parigṛhya taṃ dṛtam‌ | praṇayāmṛtapūrṇamānasaḥ smitavaktraḥ pariphullalocanaḥ || 7.52|| yamajāmyudavāha ūrjito yadi jāmbūnadavāri saṃvrajet‌ | kanakadyutimadhvasaṅgavānupamīyeta sa tena nīlabhāḥ || 7.53|| yadi rājavibhūṣaṇairyutau dvijavaryānvayajāvimau harī | nṛpagotrabhuvoḥ purā''tmanoḥ sphuṭatulyāvupagūḍhayormithaḥ || 7.54|| idamāpa vidhivadvyadhurvidhivido'sya mānanām‌ | api saṅkathā śrutisukhāḥ kavīndrayo ranayorniśamya paramāṃ mudaṃ yayuḥ || 7.58|| sajjañanāyānandavijñānamūrtīṃ prāptau pṛthvīmāśrame tatra tāvat‌ | jājvalyete ślokaughaśārṅgānvitaḥ | satsūtreṣvitihāsanandakacaṇo madhvākhyanārāyaṇaḥ prāpto vo nijighṛkṣayā dravata he māyāvidevadviṣaḥ || 12.53|| eject iti nigadati māyāvādividveṣaveṣe śubhajananikare svārāmato'smāt‌ prayātaḥ | nyavasadamaradhiṣṇye prāgryavāṭābhidhāne gurumatirabhinandan‌ devamānandamūrtim‌ || 12.54|| iti śrīmatkavikulatilaka trivikramapaṇḍitācāryasuta nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācāryaviracite śrīmatsumadhvavijaye mahākāvye ānandāṅke dvādaśaḥ sargaḥ <13> trayodaśaḥ sargaḥ pṛthudarśanamutthitaṃ kṛtārthaṃ pṛthivībhṛtpraṇatiṃ gṛhītavantam‌ | nijaśiṣyamude'tha sahyamāptaṃ puruṣaḥ kaścidupāyayau praidhitatejasā pratīcīm‌ | pariśodhayatā svapādasaṅgāt‌ pṛthivīṃ prājñadivākareṇa reje || 13.3|| aśubhānapahāya māyijuṣṭānadhamādrīniva gotranimnagaughaiḥ | sujanaistarasā'bhigamyamānaḥ paramasnehatayā kramaprasannaiḥ || 13.4|| sumanaḥphalaśobhino'tra puṃso namayan‌ gobhiranokahānivoccān‌ | api bhaṅgamupānayannanamrān‌ dṛḍhabhāvādaparānavāryavīryaḥ (dṛḍhabhāvadanaparāna) || 13.5|| gamanotsavavismitairniṣevyo vividhairjānapadairjanairajasram‌ | parisatvarakīrtirārtimuktyai puruṣairdūrabhuvaśca gamyamānaḥ (puruṣairdūrabhavaiśca)|| 6|| amarairamarānugairmunīndrairaparekṣāviṣayaiśca (aparerokṣā) sevyamānaḥ | haripādasarojasaṅgasāro bhuvane pāvanapāvano nikāmam‌ || 13.7|| ayamaprativāraṇaḥ prayāṇe paramānandasutīrthasūrirājaḥ | vibabhāvativelamaccharūpaḥ surasindhoriva santatapravāhaḥ || 13.8|| samayena gatomahīyasāsau (gato'mahīyasāsau) viṣayaṃ stambhapadopasarjanākhyam‌ | madanādhipateḥ sudhāmadhāma praviveśākhilalokavandanīyam‌ || 13.9|| kṣaṇadāmiha tāvadūṣivāṃsaṃ vihitāharmukhayogyayogamenam‌ | gamanodyamalakṣaṇairvyajānan‌ (vyarajānan‌) gamanāyodyatamāśu śiṣyasaṅghāḥ || 13.10|| purato visṛtāḥ samādhiśuddhyai yatayastatra paṭīḥ kaṣāyaveṣāḥ | sahasodaharan‌ svayogyamudrāyutadaṇḍādikadhāraṇodyamena || 13.11|| avadhārya viśeṣakāriśaṅkhaprakaṭāṅkān‌ sudhiyā gatārdrabhāvān‌ | lasitā tulasīsragasya kaṇṭhe harinirmālyatayocitā nyadhāyi || 13.12|| yatadhīrgurucakrimūrtipūrṇaṃ yataniśvāsavacā viśodhya pāṇī | guṇakuṇḍalamaṇḍitaṃ vimānaṃ guṇabaddhaṃ kavacāvṛtaṃ babhāra || 13.13|| sakamaṇḍalumaṇḍalāvalambaṃ svayamevālaghupustakādibhāram‌ | yuvaśiṣyagaṇo dadhe na yatnānna hi dākṣyasya samo'paro guṇo'sti || 13.14|| atisambhramataḥ paribhramantaṃ bharadāmānavalokinaṃ cirāya | anuyogaparaṃ muhuḥ pramattaṃ jahasurnūtanaśiṣyamatra kecit‌ || 13.15|| atha tatkṣaṇaghaṭṭitorughaṇṭāghananādavyapadeśataḥ pareṇa | amitapramatiḥ pracodito'sāviti niryatsu nijeṣu nirjagāma || 13.16|| dhṛtamātapavāraṇaṃ vareṇyaṃ vratirājaṃ tamuparyuparyudāram‌ | udayanmihiropariṣṭhapūrṇadvijarājaśriyamāyayāvabhūtām‌ | 17|| bhuvanatrayadhāriṇaṃ (bhuvanatrayabhāriṇaṃ) mukundaṃ dadhadantaḥ sa dadhe guruḥ svayaṃ ca | api kenacidityado na citraṃ nanu sa prāṇapatirvabhāra taṃ ca || 13.18|| yatayo gṛhiṇo'tha varṇimukhyāḥ śrutigāstyaktaniṣiddhakāmyabhāvāḥ | iha mūrtidharā iva svadharmāḥ śatasaṅkhyāḥ prabhumāyāntamathābhyapadyata drāk‌ | jayasiṃha imaṃ nṛsiṃhavaryaḥ śubhadhīḥ stambhaviśiṣṭasiṃhanāmā || 13.21|| avatīrya puraiva vāhanāt‌ svādapi mārgādapasārya sainikān‌ saḥ | saha kaiścana bhūsurairavāptastrijagatpūjyapadāntike nanāma || 13.22|| pṛthivīpatinā'nugamyamāno vinayādbhaktirasārdramānasena | acireṇa sa viṣṇumaṅgalasya prayayāvāyatanottamasya pārśvam‌ || 13.23|| naradevadidṛkṣayā sametā ubhayagrāmajanā janāḥ pare ca | upayāntamanantamānasaṃ taṃ muhuraikṣanta kutūhalābdhimagnāḥ || 13.24|| purato madhurasvarairvadadbhiḥ svakṛtāḥ karṇasukhā mukundagāthāḥ | dhṛtapaṅkajabījacakracihnaiḥ kṛtanṛtyai (kṛtanṛttai)ścaturairniṣevyamāṇam‌ || 13.25|| kalitāñjalinā sphuṭānuyātaṃ janasambādhasahena bhūmibhartrā | karuṇāviṣayaṃ cikīrṣuṇā svaṃ vrajatā kiṅkaratāmakaitavena || 13.26|| idamitthamitīkṣaṇairnarāṇāmaparicchedyamahiṣṭhadhāmarūpam‌ | adhikaṃ dharaṇīmalañcikīrṣuṃ sphuṭamudyantamiva dyunāthamanyam‌ || 13.27|| aśanaiḥ śanakairivāvrajantaṃ yuvasiṃhapravarapragalbhayānam‌ | atipāṭalapādapallavābhyāmavanīṃ (avaniṃ) pāvanatāmalaṃ nayantam‌ || 13.28|| nakhanirjitapadmarāgarāgaṃ varakūrmaprapadaṃ nigūḍhagulpham‌ | suravaryakarāgrasevyajaṅghaṃ dviradodārakaropamoruyugmam‌ || 13.29|| śubhaśuddhanitambabimbarājannavakauśeyaviśeṣabāhyavastram‌ | tanukukṣigalālikeṣu rekhātritayena prakaṭena śobhamānam‌ || 13.30|| mṛdusūkṣmaghanāruṇāvikācchaprakaṭaprāvaraṇena (prakaṭavaraprāvaraṇena) bhāsamānam‌ | atinūtanatigmabhānubhāsāṃ nikareṇeva suvarṇasānumantam‌ || 13.31|| pṛthuvakṣasamunnatāṃsabhittiṃ guruvṛttāyatahṛdyabāhudaṇḍam‌ | paramāruṇapāṇipallavāntaḥsphuritordhvadhvajalāñchanādimantam‌ || 13.32|| paripūrṇaśaśāṅkabimbaśaṅkāviṣayaṃ prāk‌ sahasā'valokanena | akalaṅkatayā paraṃ viviktaṃ vadanaṃ bibhratamacchavibhramābdhim‌ || 13.33|| atisundaramandahāsarājannavakundābharadaṃ śubhāruṇoṣṭham‌ | kamalāyatalocanāvalokairapi lokān‌ sakalān‌ praharṣayantam‌ || 13.34|| atibhāsurakarṇabhāsitaśrītulasīgucchamatucchakāntigaṇḍam‌ | bhuvanatrayabhūtyabhūtidāne caturabhrūvaravibhramaṃ sumaulim‌ || 13.35|| sakalāvayavān‌ sphuṭaṃ mimānāḥ pratimālakṣaṇadarśanāya lakṣyam‌ | caturā vidadhuryadīyagātraṃ sa sulakṣmetyadhunā nigadyate no || 13.36|| atiloladṛśāṃ samīkṣituṃ svaṃ janasambādhabhayena dūrabhājām‌ | samadarśayadūrdhvamoraso'sau dayayaivorujanaughamadhyago'pi || 13.37|| savikāsadṛśāṃ kṛtāñjalīnāṃ janatānāṃ paramādarānnatānām‌ | valayena vṛtaḥ priyaṃ murāreḥ praviveśāyatanaṃ prabarhabodhaḥ || 13.38|| vividhaprabhumadhyasannīṣaṇṇo naradevena samaṃ sa gūḍhadevaḥ | vibabhāvuḍurāḍivoḍumadhye saha mahyāstanayena pūrṇabimbaḥ || 13.39|| avadat‌ sa kathāṃ rathāṅgapāṇerbhagavān‌ bhāgavate bhavāpahantrīm‌ | anurūpaguṇasvarādibhājā (anurūpakūlaguṇasvarādibhājā) nijaśiṣyapravareṇa vācyamāne || 13.40|| kathanaṃ tadudāradhairyasāraṃ madhuraṃ puṣkalabhāvavat‌ prasannam‌ | viduṣo'viduṣo'pi śṛṇvato'laṃ vyadhitānandarasāmbudhau nimagnān‌ || 13.41|| gamanāsanasaṅkathādilīlāḥ smṛtimātreṇa bhavāpavargadātrīḥ | kathamapyamarāḥ prapañcayeyurnanu madhvasya na mādṛśo'lpabodhāḥ || 13.42|| sutapaḥkavitādisadguṇānāṃ likucānāṃ kulajo'ṅgironvayānām‌ | abhavadguhanāmako vipaścit‌ kavivaryo'khilavādivandanīyaḥ || 13.43|| dayitā'sya satī guṇānurūpā vidhivīryeṇa muhurmṛtaprajā'pi | abhajadbhuvanaprabhū harīśau sutakāmā vasudevasūnubhaktā || 13.44|| parameśvarayoḥ prasādayogāt‌ sutaratnaṃ tadasūta sūripatnī | pariṣatpadapattaneṣu nārgho vivide yasya samaḥ parīkṣakāgryaiḥ || 13.45|| vadanendumavekṣya nandanasya svakulottāraṇadakṣalakṣaṇasya | kṛtakṛtyatayā kriyāḥ prakurvan‌ kavirākhyāducitāṃ trivikramākhyām‌ || 13.46|| kalabhāṣaṇa eva sūripotaḥ kavirāsīdanavadyapadyavādī | avabhāti nanu prabhāprabhāvī bhagavān‌ bālatamo'pi tigmabhānuḥ || 13.47|| sakalāṅgayutāvabhātaśākhaḥ samaye prāpta udārapakṣisevyaḥ | sa sasarja sadadhvagopakṛtyai likucaḥ kāvyaphalaṃ rasābhirāmam‌ || 13.48|| pratipāditamātmanā (pratipādibhāvitamātmanā) yathārthaṃ pṛthumāyāsamayasya durghaṭatvam‌ | svagurau parihartumakṣame'pi śrutavān‌ tat‌ svavayasyabodhito'lam‌ || 13.49|| bhagavatyudite sagovilāse vaṭubhāvaṃ tyajati trivikramārye | api bhānupuraḥsarāḥ samastāḥ prayayuḥ kīṭamaṇiprabhatvamāśu || 13.50|| atidakṣamatiṃ sapādalakṣe samaye māyijanasya yuktiśūram‌ | mahitaṃ hi mahītale mahimnā janako nandanamabravīdupāṃśu || 13.51|| śṛṇu vācamimāṃ vicāritārthāṃ na kalau nirguṇabhāvanā sukhāya | iti gauṇavimuktaye guṇāḍhyaṃ smara (bhaja) devaṃ suta vāsudevameva || 13.52|| iti tātavaco niśamya kiñcit‌ taralātmā'pi vicārya śāstrasāram‌ | parameva sa pāramārurukṣurviguṇopāstimupāśṛṇot‌ parebhyaḥ || 13.53|| nijadharmarato gṛhiprabarhaḥ kalikālākulitāntaro'pi hanta | nitarāṃ niśitātmanā nisargāt‌ sphuṭamālocayadityasau kadācit‌ || 13.54|| racitaṃ nanu sūtramatra mānaṃ viduṣāṃ satyavatīsutena sākṣāt‌ | aparasparasaṅgatāni bhāṣyāṇyapi (bhāṣyāṇyatha) sarvāṇi na mānatāṃ vrajeyuḥ || 13.55|| yadi teṣu nirāgrahāntarāḥ smaḥ sughaṭaṃ nopalabhāmahe hi kiñcit‌ | na tathāpi paramparopayātaṃ na paṭhāmaḥ praṇayena sāṅkarīyam‌ || 13.56|| ghaṭanopaniṣatsu nālpabuddheḥ sughaṭetyabhyupagamya cintayāmaḥ | na vimuktimupaiti ko'pi muktvā samayoktāmiha yāmimāmupāstim‌ || 13.57|| vitataḥ sukhasaccidadvayātmā samupāsyo vihito hi tattavavidbhiḥ | sa ca nāvayavī nirūpyate ceddayutimātraṃ ca nahītyado rahasyam‌ || 13.58|| yadi cedṛgupāsyate'sya rūpaṃ timiratvena vibhāti pāriśeṣyāt‌ | phalamapyatha muktirīdṛśī syāditi no naiva dhinotyupāstireṣā || 13.59|| atha vedapurāṇabhāratādi svayamālocya yathāvabodhamatra | guṇavantamupāsmahe mukundaṃ smṛtidarmān‌ bhṛśa (spuṭa)mācaranta eva || 13.60|| avadhārya yadetikāryamāryaḥ sa vivekādupacakrame vidhātum‌ | paripūrṇamaterjagatsu kīrtiṃ paripūrṇāmaśṛṇot‌ tadā viśuddhām‌ || 13.61|| vihinasti hi no jano'tivāgmī samayaṃ ko'pi paramparopayātam‌ | kṣipa taṃ tvamapārayuktiśūro na pare tatra samarthatāṃ vrajeyuḥ || 13.62|| tava vedanadīrvigāhya bhūyaḥ samayāmbhodhiṣu kurvato vihāram‌ | navakāvyarasapriyasya vādidviradendraprativāraṇo na jajñe || 13.63|| upayāhi yaśaḥ śaśāṅkagauraṃ nijayūthasya bhayaṃ nirākuru tvam‌ | adhunā vidhinopapāditaṃ tvaṃ (taṃ) prativādiprativāraṇaṃ nivārya || 13.64|| iti māyijanena tatra tatra svajanatvena sa tāvadarthyamānaḥ | anukūlavacā mahiṣṭhamāno manasā saṃśayamāpa saṃśayacchit‌ || 13.65|| sitamadhvavacaḥsṛṇiprayoktṝn‌ puruṣāneṣa viṣādayan‌ kavībhaḥ | vividhottaradhūlipātanena pratighenādhikamandhayāñcakāra || 13.66|| kṣaṇadāsu vicakṣaṇaḥ sa vīkṣya pracuraprajñamanojñaśāstrasāram‌ | aparāviditaḥ prasādagarbhaṃ vidadhe vismayamāntaraṃ mahāntam‌ || 13.67|| viditavān‌ vyavahṛtya sudarśanaṃ bahulabodhamavekṣya sa niścayāt‌ | api na tasya mataṃ sahasā''dade nanu vimṛśya kṛtī kurute'khilam‌ || 13.68|| taṃ viṣṇumaṅgalagataṃ bahulaprabodhaṃ prāpyābhyavandata tadā'yugavikramāryaḥ | ānandadaṃ sa caturānanahāsalakṣmyā tattavaṃ pravettumamarendra ivābjayonim‌ || 13.69|| iti śrīmatkavikulatilaka trivikramapaṇḍitācāryasuta nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācāryaviracite śrīmatsumadhvavijaye mahākāvye ānandāṅke trayodaśaḥ sargaḥ <14> caturdaśaḥ sargaḥ parivṛḍhaghanasaṅghe rājasiṃhorjaśaktyā tyajati malinabhāvaṃ nīrasatvānnikāmam‌ | sphuṭamudayati tejasvyujjavale madhvabhānau sujanajalajakāntyai viśvamāsīnmanojñam‌ || 14.1|| kṛtamapakṛtamāryaiḥ kṣamyatāṃ kṣāntibhūṣai riti mṛdu vadatāṃ samprārthanābhiḥ prabhūṇām‌ | apahṛtamapareṣāṃ mantrato granthajātaṃ daśahṛdayaniyogādagrahīcchaṅkarāryaḥ || 14.2|| parivṛtamavanamrairgrāmaṇīgrāmyapūrvaiḥ avanatamurucetaḥ pādapārśve nṛsiṃham‌ | sahajavijayato'yugvikramāryaḥ prasannaḥ kavikulatilako'sāvāśiṣā'toṣayat‌ tam‌ || 14.3|| upacarati nitāntaṃ hanta paurandarīdhūrdyusadasi bhajato yaṃ durlabhā dabhrabhāgyaiḥ | diśatu sa paramānandāgryatīrthāṅghrireṇuḥ dharaṇidhara sukhaṃ te santataṃ svāntareti || 14.4|| anatiparicitasyāpyasya so'yaṃ kavīndro guṇarasamatigūḍhaṃ jñātavānityacitram‌ | madhu madhukararājo niṣpatan‌ pauṣpamāptuṃ nanu paricayahīnaḥ kānane'pi prabhuḥ syāt‌ || 14.5|| akhilakhalakulānāṃ vardhayan‌ dveṣadoṣaṃ vidadhadapi narāṇāṃ kautukaṃ madhyamānām‌ | svagatisamucitānāṃ bhūtidāyī śubhānāṃ bahulahṛdiha ninye śarvarīḥ kāścidevam‌ || 14.6|| udayati vinatāyā nandane ślādhyakāle sa kṛtasakalakṛtyaḥ kṛtyavedipravekaḥ | aruṇayavanikāntarbrahma nārāyaṇākhyaṃ guruguṇamabhidadhyau yogyayogāsanasthaḥ || 14.7|| atidhavalitadantā dantakāṣṭhaiḥ praśastairapi yugapadaneke sasnuratra vratīndrāḥ | gurubhirabhihiteṣvācārabhedeṣu niṣṭhāṃ sphuṭamavagamayantaḥ sauṣṭhavāt‌ karmaṇāṃ ca || 14.8|| caramasamayasuptāḥ pūrvamutthāya śiṣyā gurujanaparicaryāṃ cakrire duṣkarāṃ ca | sabahumati tadādyapyārdharātrāt‌ prasannāḥ | sugatiraparathaiṣāṃ syāt‌ kathaṅkāramiṣṭā || 14.9|| śravaṇamananahetoḥ prāk‌ cirāyāstanidraḥ sapadi vivaśayantyā nidrayā grastacetāḥ | svayamapi nayati drāgaṅgavastrādi pūjye jhaṭiti vigatanidraḥ ko'pi śiṣyo'nvaśeta || 14.10|| vihitamavihitaṃ prāgeva kasmādvinidraiḥ iti guruparivādāśaṅkayā namragātrāḥ | ciramanavatarantaḥ śrāvakā muktamārgā guruṣu jalasakāśastheṣu tūṣṇīmatiṣṭhan‌ || 14.11|| vipulahṛdayapārśve dīpadīptipradīpte daravaraparipūrṇairvārbhirarghyādi datvā | yatiratiyatacetāścakriṇo'rcānikāyāt‌ kusumasamitimagryāmādarādujjahāra || 14.12|| amṛtamapi nirīkṣya srāvi nirmālyasūne ghṛtamidamiti sadyo bhrāntimanto'pi śiṣyāḥ | śradadhuradhikavākyairvibhramāstacca paścāt‌ anudinamamṛtānnaistasya sevyasya śaktyā || 14.13|| agamaducitamantraistūdayānāṃ trayāṇāṃ kṛtibhiranumatātmā tatra pañcāṅgavidbhiḥ | udayamahimarociścakravartī triśaktiḥ dadhadativṛhadantaḥ ṣaḍ‌guṇaṃ svātmatejaḥ || 14.14|| timiranikarakumbhivrātamatyantatīvraṃ sthirataramakhilānāṃ prāṇināṃ ruddhamārgam‌ | bhuvanabhavanapūrṇaṃ bhānumānañjanābhaṃ haririva nakharaiḥ prāgraśmijālairnirāsa || 14.15|| madhurapatagarāvāḥ śāntanaiśāmbubāṣpāḥ sapadi vipularāgaḥ svābhisārāt‌ prasannāḥ | aruṇataraṇiratyacchāmbarā dikpurandhrīḥ smitasarasijavaktrāḥ svaiḥ karairāliliṅge || 14.16|| praṇatirabhasadhūlībaddhaśobhāviśeṣā dadhurupakṛtimattāṃ sādhujālāntarāptāḥ | samayamupanataṃ saṃvedayanto vayasyā iva daśaśataketoḥ ketavaḥ śrāvakāṇām‌ || 14.17|| nihitamucitamuccaṃ yogapīṭhaṃ pravaktuḥ pariṣadi parito'mī satvarāḥ satvabhājaḥ | drutamavasitakṛtyairdhanyasanyāsivargaiḥ śravaṇaparamakṛtyāyopatasthuḥ sametāḥ || 14.18|| premāmṛtaprasannāsyasmitāṅgāpāṅgapūrvakam‌ | śrīviṣṇutīrthanāmāsmaiḥ prītitīrthaḥ pradattavān‌ || 15.98|| śravaṇenānuvādena mananenāvṛthākarot‌ | kālaṃ vedāntaśāstrasya vedāntagurusodaraḥ || 15.99|| caturo'sau pravacane manusaṃsiddhimānmanaḥ | saṅkhyā māṃ pūraṇī māgānmadhvadāsamiti vyadhāt‌ || 15.102|| diśaṃ prayātaṃ śaśinaścarantaṃ bhuvyaśodhayat‌ | tīrthakaṃ viṣṇutīrthaṃ ca viṣṇutīrthaśca tīrthakam‌ || 15.103|| akāmānāmanekeṣāṃ siddhibhūmiṃ tapasvinām‌ | tirohitātmā prāpāsau hariścandramahīdharam‌ || 15.104|| dvandvaduḥkhānale vīro mātsaryeṇa vimatsaraḥ | tatyāja matvā tasyāsāvaśanādīndhanāyitam‌ || 15.105|| bhaktairanugiraṃ nītaṃ prārthito yatiśekharaḥ | pañcagavyaṃ papau kiñcitpañcame pañcame dine || 15.106|| sa tyajansāhasī tacca tapastepe'titāpasam‌ | bilvavarṇaiḥ kṣitau pannaistṛptimānsalilairapi || 15.107|| yatheṣṭamadhyāsta śilāṃ yamī suniyamī sa tām‌ | nādhyāsate yāmekāhaṃ daivabhagnāstapasvinaḥ || 15.108|| pavanāṃśānujo jitvā pavanaṃ recakādibhiḥ | viṣayebhyo hṛṣīkāśvān‌ manoyantrā samāharat‌ || 15.109|| smaranmurārerākāraṃ dadhyāvadhyātmakovidaḥ | samādhimādhiśamanaṃ yogalabhyaṃ sa labdhavān‌ || 15.110|| maukunde sundare rūpe svānandādiguṇārṇave | svāścaryaratne magnātmā nānyatkiñcidviveda saḥ || 15.111|| kāmatrasavihīnasya tasya sujñānacakṣuṣaḥ | vinā kaivalyasāmrājyaṃ nārgho yogamaṇerabhūt‌ || 15.112|| madhvānuje madhvanātho yaṃ prasādaṃ vyadhāttadā | sa cittāviṣayatvādvā gopyatvādvā na varṇyate || 15.113|| aho mahābodhasevāmahimā'sminyuge yataḥ | dhanyo'sau siddhimāpemāṃ so'marairityalālyata || 15.114|| tīvravrato'tīndriyavidvidyābdhistarkapaṇḍitaḥ | aniruddhapadādhāraḥ preṣṭhaḥ śiṣyastamāyayau || 15.115|| tena samprārthitaṃ prāptaṃ rūpyapīṭhamimaṃ punaḥ | kṛtsnajñaṃ kṛpayā sveṣu samprāptaṃ menire prajāḥ || 15.116|| kavīndratilako vidvacchekharastāpāsāgraṇīḥ | madhvakelīśuko'syābhūcchiṣyo vyāsapadāśrayaḥ || 15.117|| asau dāsyaṃ dhruvaṃ yāntaṃ mahāntaṃ mahatāmapi | vyadhādanugrahaṃ kurvan‌ sāmarthyaiḥ kautukaṃ nṛṇām‌ || 15.118|| āruroha durārohaṃ sa paraiḥ prītikṛddhareḥ | mahāntaṃ mahimānaṃ ca mahīdhraṃ ca guhapriyam‌ || 15.119|| ākṛṣṭo'sya guṇaivyāptairyo godāyā upāyayau | sa padmanābhatīrthākhyaḥ śiṣyo'nyo'bhūtsucetasaḥ || 15.120|| śruttayā mattayā sadā bhaktyā viraktyā nityasevayā | tasmai prasannaḥ prājyekṣaḥ sadyo vidyāṃ dadau śubhām‌ || 15.121|| vedāntābdhiṃ na yo jātu jahau vidvattimiṅgalaḥ | yuktipravāhasaṃrambhātparaśāstranadīcaraḥ || 15.122|| vyākhyāpraṇādamātreṇa vīraṃmanyānsvamaṇḍale | māyāvigrāmasiṃhān‌ yo vādisiṃho nirākarot‌ || 15.123|| mattadurvādimātaṅgatarkamastakadāraṇe | pañcāsyo yo'bhavadvyaktaṃ caturāsyo'pi kevalam‌ || 15.124|| saṅnyāyaratnāvalirapyudapādi yataḥ śubhā | ṭīkā parānuvyākhyāyāḥ anarghā bodhasāgarāt‌ || 15.125|| vedapravacanācāryaśiṣyo'sāviti pūjitaḥ | sabhyaḥ sabhāyāṃ yo vedaṃ vyācakhyau vedasāravit‌ || 15.126|| anayoḥ prathame śiṣyāścarame cābhavanniha | anantabodhasyāneke yatīndrā bahudeśajāḥ || 15.127|| vaśīkṛtahṛṣīkāśca jananādyupamardinaḥ | narasiṃhapadādhārā abhyastopendranāmakāḥ || 15.128|| adīrdhānyābhidhānā ye śrīmadrāmapadāśrayāḥ | apratyakṣaguṇodriktā bhaktivairāgyasāgarāḥ || 15.129|| pādaiḥ punantaḥ pṛthivīṃ darśayanto hareḥ padam‌ | dhūtadussamayadhvāntā ādityā iva gāṃ gatāḥ || 15.130|| mokṣaśāstrāmṛtāmbodhisevayā nitya nirvṛtāḥ | cakricārutarārcāsu cakriṇaścaraṇārcakāḥ || 15.131|| madhvapraśiṣyā bahavaḥ śiṣyā yeṣāṃ muhustathā | alañcakruralaṃ pṛthvīṃ sarve sadguṇabhūṣaṇāḥ || 15.132|| sadā sakalasacchāstravyākhyāsaukhyāmṛtābdhigāḥ | sarve durvādidurvādakāṇḍakhaṇḍaṇamaṇḍanāḥ || 15.133|| bhūribhaktibharāḥ kecidapyalpaśrutisampadaḥ | apyalpabodhā apare bahuśrutamahāguṇāḥ || 15.134|| bahavo gṛhiṇo'pyasmātsamagrānugrahaṃ yayuḥ | dīptā yatrāgnaya iva trayo likucaśekharāḥ || paraṃ padam‌ || 15.137|| śuśrūṣāpakṣapātādyaiḥ kebhyaścitkevalaṃ dadau | rāmapriyo rāma iva svāṃ gatiṃ yogidurlabhām‌ || 15.138|| śiṣyapraśiṣyātiśayā īdṛśā yaddayodayāt‌ | ko necchetsulabhaṃ bhaktyā tatpādasurapādapam‌ || 15.139|| itthaṃ sadbhiḥ sadbhirarcyo dharāyāṃ cakre vāsaṃ śeṣaśayye śayāne | grāme vātaiḥ pāvite kāṇvatīrthaiḥ bhaktaprītyā sanmaṭhe'nūnabodhaḥ || 15.140|| ānandatīrthabhagavadvadanendubimbaṃ vidyāsudhāvitatakānti sukāntikāntam‌ | yaiḥ praikṣyatātra bhavatāpaśamāyabhaktaiḥ taddāsadāsyamapi kiṃ na dadāti puṃsaḥ || 15.141|| iti śrīmatkavikulatilaka trivikramapaṇḍitācāryasuta nārāyaṇapaṇḍitācāryaviracite śrīmatsumadhvavijaye mahākāvye ānandāṅke pañcadaśaḥ sargaḥ <16> ṣoḍaśaḥ sargaḥ sādhubhyo madhumathunāṅghribhuktibhāgbhyaḥ śrautebhyo vitatamatermahānubhāvam‌ | vedāntaṃ svayamiva bandhamokṣamūlaṃ vyācaṣṭa sphuṭamatha ko'pi kovido'tra || 16.1|| gomatyāstaṭanikaṭe'cchakīrticandraṃ viśvajñaṃ kṣitipatirantyavarṇajanmā | vidveṣṭā śrutiguṇasādhakaṃ śrutīnāṃ vācālo vacanamuvāca vāgmivaryam‌ || 16.2|| unmattapralapitavanna taddhi mānaṃ yadvākyaṃ vyabhicarati kvacitphale'tra | dṛṣṭānto bhavati tadapramāṇatāyāṃ sarveṣāṃ tamasahamāna uccamānaḥ sadyo'sau nijakarapallavadvayena | ādāya vyatanuta bījamoṣadhīnāṃ sūktenāṅkuradalapuṣpabījasṛṣṭim‌ || 16.5|| vyākhyātā niśi sa kadācana pradīpe saṃśānte punarapi vācayāmbabhūva | śiṣyānsvānpurukaruṇāmbudhirnijāṅghreraṅguṣṭhasphuṭanakharāntarociṣaiva || 16.6|| tīrthārthaṃ pṛthutaravaprapātivārāṃ dhārāṇāṃ rayasahanakṣamāṃ mahekṣaḥ | ānītāṃ daśaśatapumbhiratyaśaktyā prekṣyoce vānarīkṛtātmā līlāvatkarakamalena so'malena | tatrāpi nyadhita tayā'sya sūcyate'laṃ tattuṅgāṃ nanu nikaṣā'dhunā'pi karma || 16.9|| saṅghātairadhikathanairalaṅkṛtādhvā śiṣyāṇāṃ yatamanasāmutetareṣām‌ | sakalāḥ sabālavṛddhāḥ || 16.11|| sarvajñaṃ saparijanaṃ samīkṣamāṇāḥ phullākṣāḥ smitavadanāḥ śubhāḥ nananduḥ | daurmukhyaṃ dadhata utāpare ninindurnāścarya dvayamapi tatsvabhāvatantram‌ || 16.12|| māmainaṃ bhuvanaguruṃ vinindatetthaṃ nirbhartsyābhyapatadivottaraṅgahastaḥ | saṃkṣobhī ghanaghanaghoṣaghoraveṣaḥ saṃrambhī khaladamanāya sindhurājaḥ || 16.13|| saṃmodāttaralataro drutābhigāmī gambhīrasvananutimān‌ suphenahāsaḥ | vīcyaṅgairadhikatarairihādhivelaṃ madhvāya praṇatimiva vyadhātsamudraḥ || 16.14|| golīlāsvatiśayināvagādhabhāvānnollaṅghyau vividhaguṇaprakāśaratnau | madhvābdhī 16.17|| vedānāṃ samucitabhāvavādadakṣaṃ ye vedadviṣamimamūcire maherṣyāḥ | dhik dhiktāniti janatā jagāda gāḍhaṃ (tatra) svāścaryātkila kalitāñjalirnamanti || 16.18|| sanmānaṃ vipulahṛde vidhāya bhaktyā bibhrāṇāścaraṇarajo'sya devasevyam‌ | tatsnnānādadhikaśucau nadādhirāje sasnnuste dvijanikarāḥ praśastakāle || 16.19|| kallolaiḥ karinikarairivānivāryaiḥ ullolairjananikarānnipātayadbhiḥ | janmasthityavasitidāyinaṃ kaṭākṣaṃ lokānāmaghaṭayadambudhau bṛhaddhīḥ | ākrānto'dhikaguruṇā sa tena tāvan‌ muñcansañcalanamabhūttaṭākadeśyaḥ || 16.23|| ityādyairapi caritairananyasādhyaiḥ na stheṣṭhāṃ bahumatimāpa durjano'smin‌ | vidveṣaṃ vyadhita punarnirastabhāgye tasmindurmanasi tadeva śobhanaṃ syāt‌ || 16.24|| samprāptaṃ saha sahajena gaṇḍavāṭaṃ svojassamprakaṭana ādiśadviśaṅkam‌ | śuśrūṣāmayamucito vidhātumīṣallokānāmiti vacasā parīkṣakāṇām‌ || 16.25|| śrīkanteśvarasadane'nayatkilaiko yastriṃśannaravaranītaketuyaṣṭim‌ | āhatyāgurugadayaiva nārikelādyo lebhe taralatarātphalāni kāmam‌ || 16.26|| etādṛgbalavibhavaḥ sa tasya kaṇṭhaṃ tajjayeṣṭho'pyabhita ubhau samaṃ gṛhītvā | niṣpeṣṭuṃ paramamavāpatuḥ prayatnaṃ saṅgharṣātkramaparivardhamānataikṣṇyam‌ || 16.27|| āsvinnāvalasatarau gurorniyogācchatrāgnyānilamahitau ca tāvubhābhyām‌ | muktvā'yaḥ kaṭhinataratvacaṃ śirodhiṃ paryāyasphuṭavacanāṃ nipetatuḥ kau || 16.28|| āśvastau śucihṛdimāvanūnamānāvuddhartuṃ samagadadaṅgulīṃ dharāsthām‌ | saṅgṛhya prasabharasādatiprayatnau (prasabharasādapi prayattau) sāmarthyaṃ yayaturimau na kampane'syāḥ || 16.29|| niryatnaṃ vaṭumadhiruhya mandahāsī sa prāyādiha parito nirdeśādvyadhita gurorgalaprapeṣam‌ || 16.31|| svinne'sminnapi yatamāna āgrahogre prācyāttatpravacananisvano'tireje | uddhartuṃ vipulahṛdaṅguliṃ ca nālaṃ so'bhūdityajani kutūhalaṃ janānām‌ || 16.32||
